title: VSL VIDEO EDITOR — LONG-TERM PARTNERSHIP (E-commerce D2C)
description:
Let me be upfront with you, because that's how we operate.



We're a D2C e-commerce brand in the women's health space. We sell a product that genuinely helps people, and every piece of content we produce reflects that. No misleading claims. No bait-and-switch.



We're into a 5-year vision. We're scaling aggressively in the English-speaking market, and we need editors who grow with us, not editors who disappear when a bigger project comes along, and not a company that goes quiet after 3 months because the brand didn't work out.



We're in this for the long game. We want you to be too.



- THE ROLE:



Position: Direct Response VSL Video Editor (Health/Pain Relief Specialist)

Commitment: Full-time, long-term (this is not a freelance gig)

Compensation: $1,250-$1,500 monthly + performance bonuses

Location: 100% remote

Hours: 40h/week

Market: English-speaking



- WHAT LONG-TERM ACTUALLY MEANS HERE:



- Year-over-year salary increases of 10–20% for strong performers

- Performance bonuses tied directly to VSL and ad conversion rates

- Creative ownership, you won't be executing someone else's vision blindly. You'll understand the strategy, the avatar, the psychology behind every piece of content

- A real team, you'll work closely with the founder and marketing lead, not get lost in a ticket queue



- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



Non-negotiable:



- 2+ years editing Direct Response VSLs ads (health/women's wellness a strong plus)

- Proven retention, you understand why a cut happens at second 4, not just how to make it

- Proficiency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects

- Experience with AI video tools (HeyGen, Veo, etc.)



Strong preference:



- You've edited ads that actually ran and converted

- You understand
/Instagram ad formats and platform behavior

- You've worked with health or wellness brands and know the compliance landscape



- WHO THRIVES HERE:



You care about the work beyond the deliverable. You watch your edited videos after they go live and wonder how to make the next one better. You understand that a 3-second hook isn't decoration, it's the difference between a winning creative and a dead one.



You want to be part of something being built, not just service it.



- WHO THIS IS NOT FOR:



If you're looking to freelance across 6 clients simultaneously, this isn't the right fit. We want someone who is genuinely invested in one brand's growth, because that's where the real upside is.



- THE PROCESS:



We review every application carefully. Portfolio quality matters far more than volume. If your work is strong and your approach is right, you'll hear from us within a week.



We move fast, but we don't rush the decision on people.

title: Social Media & Facebook Community Lead Generation Assistant – Australian Business
description:
Job Description



Social Media &
 Community Lead Generation Assistant



 About the Role



We are an Australian business looking for a reliable and proactive Social Media &
 Community Lead Generation Assistant to support our growth.



This is not a traditional social media role focused only on creating posts.



A major part of the role will involve identifying relevant
 groups and online communities, monitoring discussions, spotting potential opportunities, engaging appropriately in writing, and helping generate genuine enquiries for the business.



The successful applicant will work remotely and report directly to the business owner.



This is intended to become a long-term contractor position for the right person.



Key Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



* Creating and scheduling regular social media posts

* Helping develop useful and engaging content

* Monitoring comments and messages on business social media accounts

* Responding to simple written enquiries using approved information and templates

* Identifying relevant
 groups and online communities

* Joining and monitoring appropriate
 groups

* Reading group rules and ensuring all activity complies with those rules

* Identifying posts or discussions where someone may be looking for services relevant to the business

* Engaging naturally and professionally in written conversations where appropriate

* Avoiding spam, aggressive selling or inappropriate promotion

* Passing genuine leads and more complex enquiries to the business owner

* Maintaining a simple record of leads and where they came from

* Monitoring competitors and relevant industry activity

* Identifying businesses announcing closures, changes or other developments that may create opportunities

* Providing a short weekly summary of activity, leads and useful market information



 Group Research



 community engagement will be an important part of this role.



You will be expected to:



* Search for relevant
 groups

* Assess whether groups contain genuine potential customers or referral opportunities

* Keep a database of useful groups

* Record group size, activity level and posting rules

* Identify which groups allow business promotion

* Monitor relevant conversations regularly

* Flag high-quality opportunities quickly



The objective is quality rather than simply joining hundreds of groups.



Lead Generation



You will help identify potential leads through social media and
 groups.



However, you will not be expected to:



* Make sales calls

* Speak with potential customers by telephone or video

* Provide professional or technical advice

* Make commitments on behalf of the business

* Handle complaints or sensitive situations independently

* Pressure people into using our services



Where someone has a genuine enquiry, your role is to make an appropriate initial written response and then refer the enquiry to the business owner.



Content



You will assist with approximately three to four social media posts each week.



Content may include:



* Helpful information

* Frequently asked questions

* Industry updates

* Educational posts

* Business information

* Service explanations

* Community-focused content



The aim is to build trust and visibility rather than constantly advertise.



You should be comfortable using tools such as Canva and social media scheduling platforms.



Communication



Excellent written English is essential.



You must be able to write in a natural, professional and friendly way suitable for an Australian audience.



We do not want responses that sound robotic, overly formal or obviously AI-generated.



You should also be comfortable following approved scripts and knowing when an enquiry needs to be escalated.



Skills and Experience



We are looking for someone with experience in some or all of the following:



* Social media management

*
 community engagement

*
 group research

* Lead generation

* Content scheduling

* Canva

* Written customer engagement

* Community management

* Competitor research

* Basic CRM or spreadsheet management



Previous experience working with an Australian, UK, US, Canadian or similar English-speaking business would be an advantage.



Experience in healthcare, disability, professional services or other regulated industries would also be useful, but is not essential.



Personal Attributes



The right person will be:



* Reliable

* Organised

* Proactive

* Confident using initiative

* Comfortable researching independently

* Able to follow instructions

* Careful with details

* Professional in written communication

* Able to recognise when something needs to be escalated

* Comfortable working without constant supervision



We particularly value someone who can identify opportunities rather than simply wait to be given tasks.



Reporting



You will provide a simple weekly report covering:



* Posts published

*
 groups identified

* New groups joined

* Relevant conversations found

* Leads generated

* Enquiries passed to the business owner

* Competitor or industry developments identified

* Any issues or recommendations



Hours



Initially, we expect this role to require approximately 10–15 hours per week.



Hours may increase as the role and business grow.



The role is flexible, although some activity should occur during Australian business hours so that relevant conversations and enquiries can be identified promptly.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to develop a long-term working relationship.



As the business grows, the role may expand into broader digital marketing, community engagement, lead management and market research.



Important



This role is about genuine community engagement.



We are not looking for someone who:



* Spams
 groups

* Sends large numbers of unsolicited messages

* Copies and pastes promotional comments everywhere

* Buys followers

* Uses fake engagement

* Makes exaggerated marketing claims



We want someone who understands that good social media lead generation comes from being useful, visible, professional and trustworthy.

title: Finance & Loan Administrator VA - must have Australian finance and mortgage broking experience
description:
We are looking for an experienced Finance & Loan Administrator VA to support a growing Australian finance and mortgage broking business.



The business handles asset finance, commercial loans, and home loans for self-employed individuals and business clients. The successful candidate will support the broking team throughout the loan lifecycle, helping ensure applications, documents, lender submissions, and follow-ups are handled accurately and efficiently.



This role is ideal for someone with previous experience in Australian mortgage broking, loan processing, finance administration, or loan administration who understands how to manage loan applications and keep multiple deals moving through the pipeline.



This is a part-time role of approximately 20 hours per week, with the potential to increase to full-time as the business grows.



Key Responsibilities

Loan & Deal Administration

Prepare, review, and package loan application documents.

Ensure all required documents and information are complete before submission.

Track loan applications through assessment, approval, and settlement.

Maintain accurate records throughout the loan process.

Document Collection & Follow-Up

Follow up clients for outstanding documents and information.

Liaise with lenders, referrers, brokers, and other third parties.

Monitor outstanding requirements and ensure files continue progressing.

Keep loan files complete, organised, compliant, and audit-ready.

Client & Broker Support

Communicate with clients after onboarding and provide updates on their application progress.

Respond to client enquiries professionally and promptly.

Coordinate with brokers and internal team members regarding next steps.

Assist in ensuring a smooth experience for clients throughout the loan process.

CRM & Pipeline Management

Maintain accurate client records and deal statuses in the CRM.

Update and manage loan pipelines to ensure no applications or follow-ups are missed.

Experience with GoHighLevel CRM is highly regarded.

Build and maintain simple SOPs for recurring administrative tasks.

Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes and workflow efficiency.



What We're Looking For

Previous experience in loan processing, mortgage broking support, loan administration, or finance administration.

Experience supporting Australian mortgage brokers, lenders, or finance businesses is highly preferred.

Familiarity with lender portals and loan application processes.

Experience preparing and checking loan application documents.

Understanding of the loan process from application through to settlement.

Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Good understanding of compliance and document requirements.

Comfortable following up clients and third parties for outstanding information.

Experience managing multiple loan applications or deals simultaneously.

CRM experience; GoHighLevel experience is an advantage.

Confident using Microsoft Teams and Google Workspace.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Highly organised, reliable, and able to work independently.



Highly Regarded

Australian mortgage broking or finance industry experience.

Experience processing home loans, commercial loans, or asset finance.

Experience using lender portals.

Experience with GoHighLevel CRM.

Experience creating SOPs and improving administrative workflows.



Application Questions

How many years of experience do you have in loan processing, mortgage broking support, or finance administration?

We primarily use

What You’ll Be Doing

This may include:



Building complex 
 or Zapier workflows

Setting up routers, filters, iterators, aggregators, webhooks, and error handling

Connecting Airtable to live automation pipelines

Creating AI workflows using Claude and ChatGPT

Designing structured prompts that produce consistent outputs

Connecting AI outputs into tools like Airtable, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and other platforms

Reading API documentation and building integrations independently

Troubleshooting failed automations, mapping issues, and authentication errors

Documenting systems clearly so another person can maintain them

Similar advanced workflow automation platforms

REST API integrations

HTTP modules

OAuth 2.0 authentication

Webhooks

Claude and ChatGPT workflows

Prompt engineering

Error handling and automation troubleshooting

Documentation and SOP creation



You Are a Good Fit If You:



Can build complex workflows without needing step-by-step guidance

Can troubleshoot using logs and testing, not guesswork

Communicate clearly and proactively

Document your work properly

Care about building clean, reliable, scalable systems

Can work independently in a remote setup



Important

 workflows, or experimenting with AI prompts only.



We are looking for someone who has built real automation systems used in an actual business or client environment.

/Zapier scenarios, Airtable builds, API integrations, or AI workflows you have created.

title: Property Management Virtual Assistant (Australian Property Management is a MUST)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Property Management Virtual Assistant to provide administrative and operational support to Australian real estate agencies.



The role will involve supporting the day-to-day management of residential and/or commercial property portfolios, including property and tenancy onboarding, maintenance coordination, arrears, invoicing, compliance, inspections, and general property administration.



This is a phone-facing role, so clear and easily understood spoken English is essential. You will communicate with tenants, landlords, property owners, tradespeople, and other relevant parties while helping ensure that all property management tasks are completed accurately and on time.



We are particularly looking for candidates with Australian property management experience, ideally those who have managed or supported a residential rent roll and/or commercial property portfolio.



Experience using Console (Reapit) is strongly preferred and may be a key requirement.



Key Responsibilities

Property & Tenancy Administration

Assist with onboarding new properties into the property management system.

Set up and maintain property, owner, and tenant profiles.

Upload, organise, and maintain tenancy and property documentation.

Ensure records are complete, accurate, and easily accessible.

Assist with lease renewals, rent reviews, and tenancy administration.

Maintain accurate property and tenancy records throughout the management lifecycle.

Arrears & Tenancy Management

Run and monitor rent and water arrears.

Follow up tenants regarding outstanding payments.

Prepare breach notices and other tenancy-related documentation where required.

Assist with tribunal applications and case management.

Track important dates, notice periods, and tenancy requirements accurately.

Ensure tasks are completed in line with relevant Australian tenancy legislation and client procedures.

Maintenance Coordination

Receive and log maintenance requests from tenants via phone,
, text, or maintenance portals.

Review maintenance requests and record all relevant information.

Liaise with property owners regarding quotes, approvals, and next steps.

Obtain quotes and issue or assist with work orders.

Coordinate with tradespeople and contractors.

Follow up outstanding maintenance jobs through to completion.

Ensure completion invoices are received, uploaded, and allocated correctly.

Keep property management records updated throughout the maintenance process.

Routine Inspections & Compliance

Schedule, notify, and reschedule routine inspections.

Prepare and send inspection notices within the required timeframes.

Maintain inspection-related documentation.

Track compliance due dates and required certificates.

Monitor and maintain records for:

Smoke alarm compliance

Water efficiency compliance

Pool compliance

Other legislative or property-specific requirements

Contact trades or service providers to arrange inspections, servicing, or recertification.

Ensure compliance documentation is accurately saved and readily available.

Accounts & Financial Administration

Process rent receipts and reconcile transactions.

Enter and manage maintenance invoices and other property-related expenses.

Process invoices for council rates, water rates, levies, land tax, and other payables.

Raise tenant invoices where required.

Monitor due dates and outstanding invoices.

Maintain accurate and organised financial records.

Attach and file invoices and receipts appropriately.

Support property accounting and financial administration using Xero and property management software.



Note: The role will not require access to bank logins. Financial tasks will be completed through approved accounting and property management systems only.



Communication & General Administration

Manage and triage
s and inbox enquiries.

Take and screen phone calls from tenants, landlords, property owners, trades, and other stakeholders.

Respond to general enquiries professionally and efficiently.

Maintain shared task lists and ensure follow-ups are completed.

Prepare reports and provide updates to the Property Manager or Business Owner.

Send a brief end-of-day report outlining completed tasks, outstanding items, and required follow-ups.

Assist with general document management, filing, and workflow improvements.

Support ad hoc property management and administrative tasks as required.

Light Marketing Support

Create simple Canva graphics when required.

Assist with basic social media or website updates.

Support general marketing and administrative tasks as needed.

What We're Looking For

Previous experience as a Property Management VA, Property Manager, Assistant Property Manager, Property Administrator, or Leasing/Property Management Support professional.

Australian property management experience is essential.

Experience supporting or managing an Australian residential rent roll and/or commercial property portfolio.

Experience with Console (Reapit) is strongly preferred; experience with other Australian property management platforms may also be considered.

Experience supporting a Victorian real estate agency and managing Victorian properties is highly regarded, particularly for commercial property management requirements.

Strong understanding of Australian property management processes.

Familiarity with Australian residential and/or commercial tenancy legislation, notice periods, and compliance requirements.

South Australian tenancy experience is highly regarded for clients managing SA residential properties.

Confident using Xero, particularly for receipting, reconciliation, invoice entry, and payables.

Excellent attention to detail, particularly when managing dates, notice periods, invoices, and compliance requirements.

Clear, professional, and easily understood spoken English is essential.

Comfortable handling phone calls and communicating directly with tenants, landlords, owners, tradespeople, and other stakeholders.

Highly organised and able to manage multiple tasks and priorities independently.

Proactive, reliable, and results-focused.

Software Experience



Experience with the following is highly desirable:



Console / Reapit – strongly preferred

Xero

Other Australian property management platforms

Microsoft Office

Google Workspace

Canva



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is an experienced Australian Property Management professional or VA who can confidently support a busy property portfolio with minimal supervision.



They should be comfortable handling phone calls, tenancy administration, maintenance coordination, arrears, compliance, inspections, and property-related financial administration.



Most importantly, we are looking for someone with clear spoken English, strong Australian property management experience, excellent attention to detail, and preferably hands-on experience using Console (Reapit).



Application Questions

How many years of experience do you have in Australian property management?

Have you supported or managed an Australian residential rent roll, commercial property portfolio, or both? Please describe your experience.

Have you worked with a Victorian real estate agency or managed properties located in Victoria? Please provide details.

Which property management software have you used? Please indicate your level of experience with Console (Reapit).

What property management tasks have you personally handled?

(e.g., arrears, lease renewals, breach notices, maintenance coordination, inspections, compliance, invoicing, tenant communication, tribunal applications, etc.)

Do you have experience using Xero for receipting, reconciliation, invoice entry, or payables?

Are you comfortable handling inbound and outbound phone calls with tenants, landlords, property owners, and tradespeople as part of your daily responsibilities?

Do you have experience working with Australian tenancy legislation, notice periods, and compliance requirements? If yes, which Australian state or territory have you supported?

- Confident using AI tools in your workflow

title: Experienced QBO Bookkeeper - Canadian Firm (PST Hours)
description:
We are a Canadian cloud-accounting firm specializing in bookkeeping, payroll, fractional CFO, and fractional controllership services.



We are looking for an experienced Quickbooks Online Bookkeeper to join our team. This is a full-time remote position with a fixed monthly salary, averaging 40 hours per week. Hours WILL fluctuate week to week based on client needs and where we are in the month, busier during peak periods such as the beginning of the month and lighter at other times. Candidates should be comfortable with this ebb and flow, and with the workload evening out to full-time over the course of the month.



As a fully remote and growing firm in a startup environment, we foster a collaborative and flexible workplace, offering opportunities to take on new challenges, improve processes, and grow with us.



As a Bookkeeper, you will manage financial records for multiple clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with accounting standards. This role requires strong attention to detail, high ownership, the ability to work independently, and excellent communication skills.



This is a multi-client role. You'll be juggling several client files at once, each with its own deadlines, quirks, and priorities. We need someone who is genuinely comfortable with that, not just tolerating it, but able to stay organized when priorities shift or deadlines tighten.





DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES



• Maintain accurate client financial records, including bank and credit card reconciliations, GL entries, and receipts

Reconcile monthly client schedules and ensure tasks are completed on time and accurately



• Actively review client books, not just process transactions. We need someone who looks at the numbers, notices when something doesn't add up, and understands why, not someone who enters data and moves on.



• Proactively flag and triage issues. Once you're fully onboarded and trained, we expect you to identify discrepancies or red flags on your own, assess how urgent they are, and raise them appropriately without needing to be asked.



• Resolve discrepancies and provide timely client support



• Assist with month-end and year-end reporting and workpaper preparation



• Manage increased workload during month-end close periods (for example, the 1st to 18th of the month will be the busiest, closing out the prior month)





QUALIFICATIONS



• 3+ years of North American bookkeeping experience, with a solid understanding of general ledger accounting and full-cycle bookkeeping

• Philippine CPA designation is preferred but not required

• Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is required (not just familiarity). You should be comfortable working in QBO daily across multiple client files, along with strong Excel skills

• Experience working with multiple clients in an accounting firm is strongly preferred

• High ownership and agency. You take responsibility for your files, don't wait to be told what to do next, and follow through without needing reminders

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines across several clients simultaneously

• Responsive communication. We expect a response within the same business day on client and internal matters

• Analytical and critical thinking abilities to solve problems efficiently

• Strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently while meeting multiple deadlines

• A commitment to exceptional customer service, with previous client-facing experience

• Previously have worked for an accountant or in a firm environment is preferred, not required.





LOCATION & HOME OFFICE REQUIREMENTS

• Our business are are 9 AM - 5 PM PST.  You are expected to work at 4 hours in a day that is within our business hours PST.

• This role is fully remote, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home.

• Reliable high-speed internet (50 Mbps minimum)

• Quiet workspace suitable for client calls and focused work.

• A modern laptop or desktop capable of running QuickBooks Online, spreadsheets, and video calls.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Attention to Detail: Accuracy and precision are ESSENTIAL

• Ownership & Agency: We're looking for someone who treats client files as their own, works consistently across the month • rather than in bursts, and doesn't need to be chased for updates

• Clear Thinking & Communication: The ability to explain issues, ask the right questions, respond promptly, and document work clearly is crucial

• Willingness to Learn: We look for people who are eager to grow, learn new tools, and take on new challenges

• Reliability & Follow-Through: We seek individuals who take responsibility for their work, meet deadlines, and follow through consistently

• Curiosity & Problem-Solving: Asking thoughtful questions, exploring discrepancies, and seeking better ways to complete tasks is important. Once trained, you should be able to spot and triage issues on your own, without waiting for direction





WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

• We're intentional about building a team of A-players: people with a strong desire to learn, grow, and level up their skillset

• You'll be supported by leadership who genuinely want to see you succeed and are fully invested in your professional development at the firm

• A collaborative and transparent team culture where questions are encouraged and support is always available

• A stable, permanent role with predictable workflows and steady client files





HOW TO APPLY



1. Submit your resume and a Loom video (2–4 minutes) using a URL link. Generic or template videos will not be accepted. Your video should specifically address:



a. A quick introduction

b. What you like doing in your spare time (hobbies, interests, etc.)

c. What made you apply for this role specifically



2. Video Interview with Management team to assess experience and skills

title: Business Development & Technical Recruiter (Tech Industry)
description:
About RSGV Services

RSGV Services is a disruptor in the tech recruitment space. We have built our reputation on a highly successful Reverse Recruiting model—where we represent top-tier tech talent and navigate the job market on their behalf.



Because of our unique model, we have something most traditional agencies lack: An immediate, pre-vetted pool of high-quality tech candidates ready to work. We are now looking for an experienced Recruiter/Business Developer to help us launch our Traditional Recruiting Arm by connecting our elite talent pool with companies that are hiring.



The Role

Unlike traditional roles where you spend 80% of your time hunting for candidates, at RSGV, the talent is already here. Your mission is to find the companies.



We need a "Hunter"—someone who can identify companies with hiring needs, establish professional partnerships, and place our existing candidates into those roles. You will be responsible for the full client-side lifecycle, from lead generation to contract signing.



Key Responsibilities

B2B Lead Generation: Identify tech companies, startups, and hiring managers with active or upcoming vacancies.



Client Acquisition: Execute cold outreach and networking strategies to pitch RSGV’s recruitment services and our exclusive candidate pool.



Strategic Matchmaking: Leverage our internal database of pre-vetted "Reverse Recruiting" candidates to fill the roles you acquire.



Communication & Negotiation: Act as the primary bridge between hiring managers and our candidates, managing interview flows and offer negotiations.



Department Growth: Help us build the "Traditional Recruiting" playbook from the ground up.



Requirements

Experience: 2+ years of experience in Agency Recruiting, B2B Sales, or Business Development within the Tech sector.



Lead Gen Mastery: Proven ability to find hiring leads using tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or similar platforms.



Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills. You must be comfortable pitching to CTOs and HR Directors.



Self-Starter: You are comfortable working independently in a startup environment and are motivated by closing deals.



Tech Literacy: A solid understanding of technical roles (Software Engineers, DevOps, Data Scientists, etc.) is essential.



Why Join Us?

Unfair Advantage: You don't have to source candidates from scratch; you’ll have immediate access to a high-quality talent pool.



Growth Potential: We are looking for someone to grow with us. This role starts as part-time but is designed to transition into a full-time leadership position as the department scales.



Flexibility: 100% remote work.

title: Senior Accountant / Bookkeeper – Xero & CFO Reporting
description:

Location: Philippines – Remote / Work From Home

Employment: Part-Time

Working Hours: Some availability during Melbourne, Australia business hours required



About CareWell Diagnostix



CareWell Diagnostix is a growing Australian diagnostic imaging organisation operating multiple clinics across Melbourne.



We are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant / Bookkeeper who can manage day-to-day bookkeeping accurately while also providing management accounting, financial analysis and CFO-level reporting support as our business continues to grow.



This role is ideal for someone who doesn't just enter numbers into Xero but can understand what the numbers are telling management.



Key Responsibilities



Bookkeeping & Accounting



Maintain accurate financial records in Xero

Bank and credit card reconciliations

Accounts payable and accounts receivable

Supplier invoice processing and reconciliation

Payroll-related accounting support

GST/BAS preparation support

Month-end reconciliations and closing

Maintain accurate chart of accounts

Identify and investigate discrepancies

Maintain supporting financial documentation

Liaise with our Australian accountant and management when required



Management Accounting & CFO Reporting



Prepare monthly Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow reports

Develop management reporting packs and dashboards

Analyse actual performance against budgets

Prepare budgets and financial forecasts

Monitor cash flow and prepare cash-flow forecasts

Analyse expenses and identify unusual cost movements

Analyse revenue and profitability trends

Provide clinic/location-level financial performance analysis

Assist management to understand margins and cost drivers

Develop meaningful financial KPIs

Provide variance analysis and explanations

Assist with financial modelling for new clinics, equipment and business investments

Help management identify opportunities to improve profitability and financial efficiency

Present financial information in simple, practical language to management

Who We Are Looking For



Ideally, you will have:



Accounting degree or equivalent professional qualification

3–5+ years of accounting/bookkeeping experience

Strong hands-on Xero experience

Previous experience working with an Australian business

Strong knowledge of AP, AR, reconciliations and month-end accounting

Experience preparing management accounts and financial reports

Strong understanding of P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow

Budgeting and forecasting experience

Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Ability to analyse financial data rather than simply process transactions

Excellent written and spoken English

High attention to detail

Strong integrity and confidentiality

Ability to work independently and take ownership



Experience with Australian GST/BAS, payroll, healthcare, medical businesses or multi-site organisations would be highly regarded.



CPA/CA or equivalent accounting qualification would also be highly regarded.



What We Really Want



We are looking for someone who can operate at two levels.



At the first level, you need to ensure our books are accurate, reconciled and up to date.



At the second level, we want you to step back from the transactions and help management answer questions such as:



Where are we making money?

Where are we losing money?

What is changing month to month?

What is our cash-flow position?

Which clinic or area is performing best?

Are our costs increasing faster than revenue?

What should management be paying attention to?



We don't just want financial reports generated.



We want someone who can explain what the reports mean and recommend what management should investigate or consider doing next.



What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means CareWell management has:



Accurate and up-to-date Xero accounts

Reliable monthly financial reporting

Clear visibility of cash flow

Better understanding of clinic profitability

Visibility of outstanding receivables and liabilities

Budgets and forecasts that are regularly reviewed

DrayEasy Inc is a steadily developing international enterprise. We are seeking a versatile HR Specialist based in the Philippines to independently conduct full-cycle human resource operations. This role emphasizes employee relations management, requiring candidates to be adaptable and detail-oriented in a fast-paced working environment. Fluent in Chinese is a strong plus.



Job Summary

The HR Specialist will be in charge of end-to-end recruitment, personnel transfer & separation, performance management, one-on-one employee counseling, staff care, and training arrangements. title: WhatsApp Follow-Up Specialist — Singapore Property Team (Full Time, Mon–Fri, Singapore Hours, No Night Shift)
description:
Who I am

I run a licensed property team in Singapore — me and four agents under me.



You report to me. Only me.



The four agents are people you help. They can tell you what to say to their own leads — their own words, their own templates. That is fine, just show me before you change anything.



But your hours, your tasks, your daily list, your pay — that is me. Nobody else. You will never be pulled five ways.



I have been hiring Filipino staff for real estate teams for over 8 years. I have 2 full-time Filipino team members with me right now. You will not be my experiment. I pay on time, every time.



The problem I need you to fix



My team has too many leads.



Here is what happens. A person messages one of my agents and says "I'm thinking of upgrading to a better home, but maybe next year." The agent replies. Then the agent forgets them. Six months later they buy a home through somebody else.



We are not losing money because we lack leads. We lose money because nobody follows up.



That is your whole job. You are the person who never forgets.



What you will actually do every day



Reply to new leads on my team WhatsApp. Ask the questions I give you. Book them in.



Reply to Instagram DMs too. Same job, different app.



Message 50 to 70 old leads a day from my second WhatsApp number. I give you the list and the scripts. You do not write from scratch. I will also help you find ways to make your job easier with automation.



Ask 4 simple questions to check if the person is the right fit.



Look at my agents' Google Calendars and book the meeting into the right one.

Log every reply in my Google Sheet or CRM. Set the next follow-up date. Never let a name go cold.

When a lead asks something you don't know, pass it to me or the agent. Do not guess.



You will NOT be cold calling. This is typing only.

You will NOT be doing social media posting, video editing, or graphic design.

You will NOT need to know Singapore property. I train you.



Your numbers



50 to 70 follow-up messages sent, every working day.

Every lead who replies gets an answer within 30 minutes.

No lead sits with no next follow-up date. Ever.

Qualified appointments booked — this is what I pay your bonus on.



Hours — read this part carefully



9:00am to 6:00pm Singapore time, Monday to Friday.

Singapore is the same time zone as the Philippines. So 9am here is 9am there.

No night shift. No graveyard. No weekends. You work normal daytime hours and you eat dinner with your family.

Short Google Meet with me every morning. Camera on.



Pay



S$600 to S$800 per month, depending on your experience. Tell me your number.

Paid twice a month — every 15th and every 30th. Not once a month.

S$10 bonus for every qualified appointment you book, up to 50 a month. That is up to S$500 extra.

S$50 perfect attendance bonus every month.

13th month bonus after you pass probation. Prorated for your first year.

1 month probation. If you are not a good fit, no love lost, we say our goodbyes.



A good month: S$800 base + S$250 bonus + S$50 attendance = S$1,100.



You must be comfortable working with AI



I use AI every day. You will too.



I will give you an AI helper that knows my business. When you are stuck — a lead asks something odd, you don't know how to word a reply — you ask the AI first, before you ask me.



You don't need to be a tech person. You don't need to code. You just need to be the type who tries the new tool instead of avoiding it.



If AI makes you nervous, this is not the job.



What I need from you



You have followed up with customers before. Chat,
, or phone — any of it counts. Tell me what you did.

You can type clear, simple English. Short sentences. No fancy words.

You have a proper desk and a quiet room. Not a bed, not a noisy house. I will ask for a photo.

Stable internet and a working webcam. The daily meeting is on camera.

You are fine with Hubstaff time tracking. I use it every day, screenshots included. If this bothers you, do not apply.

You can use Google Sheets and Google Calendar.



Nice to have, not required



You have made sales or follow-up phone calls before. I don't need you to call, but people who can call are usually braver on chat.

You have worked with a CRM before.

Real estate experience. Truly optional. I train you.



How to apply



Change your subject line to exactly: "I will send 50 messages a day" - If not then I know you've not read the application throughly



Send a short message. Tell me one time you followed up with a customer who had gone quiet, and what happened.



Tell me one way you have used AI at work or at home. ChatGPT, Claude, anything. If you have never used it, say so honestly and tell me why you are willing to learn.



Attach a photo of your work desk. Just as it is. I am not judging how expensive it is — I want to see it is a real work space.



Tell me the salary you want, in Singapore dollars.



Attach your resume link.



If your subject line is wrong, or there is no desk photo, I will skip you. Not to be difficult — this job is about following instructions carefully, every single day.



Short Google Meet interview with me, camera on.

Inside, you'll find the reference video, the raw footage, and a "Further Directions" file. Read that file before you start.



POSITION



Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor — $1,000+/mo — Established TikTok/UGC Page (Long-Term Role)



TYPE / SALARY



Full Time · 5–6 days per week · PH or similar time zone $1,000 USD/month starting, potential for performance bonuses. Raises tied to skill and results.



JOB DESCRIPTION



I run a TikTok page and produce UGC that consistently reaches large audiences. I'm looking for one editor to take ownership of the editing work alongside me, long term.



Success in this role comes down to two things above all else: editing quality and English comprehension. Because of that, this posting is specific about what the work requires, and the application asks for more than a résumé. I'd rather be clear upfront than have either of us discover a mismatch a month in.



THE WORK



Daily short-form vertical content — mostly talking heads with occasional voiceover/b-roll:



Cutting dead space so videos stay paced and never drag

Stitching the strongest takes into one seamless piece

Adding image overlays on screen to support what's being said

Zooms, crops, and reframes to keep the frame dynamic

B-roll builds: I provide a voiceover and footage, you find the visual that matches each line

Sourcing your own overlay assets — reading the script and independently finding the images it calls for



The last two items are the core of the role. The rest is technical work most editors can learn. Choosing the right visual for the right sentence is what separates a video that reaches 4,000 people from one that reaches 4,000,000.



SOURCING YOUR OWN ASSETS



This is one of the most important parts of the job, and the part most editors are not set up for. I'll give you background and direction, but I want you fully self-sufficient at finding the visuals a script needs. That means:



Reading the script and working out which images the moment actually calls for

Finding high-quality, aesthetically strong photos of who/what is being discussed — not the first search result, but the image that looks right on screen

Learning the brands I work with well enough to represent them correctly

Knowing which parts of a brand's website are worth capturing, and pulling clean screenshots of them

Sourcing relevant comments, posts, and screenshots that support the point being made

Placing every asset at the right moment in the video, on the beat the script lands on



I shouldn't have to send you an image folder for a video to get made. You should be able to take the script and go find what it needs.



This requires genuinely understanding English — hearing a sentence and catching the humor, the tone, the reference — because you can't source the right image for a line you don't fully understand. Your English does not need to be perfect. It needs to be strong enough that you follow everything being said and that we can communicate quickly and clearly. Familiarity with internet and pop culture is a significant advantage here, and it's rewarded.



EXAMPLES OF THE WORK



Please watch all three before applying so you know exactly what you'd be producing.



Basic talking head — cutting dead space, piecing clips together, light crops and zooms: 

Talking head with overlays — the same, plus supplied images placed on screen: 

B-roll — a voiceover with footage matched to it line by line. This is where English comprehension shows most: 



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR

Strong attention to detail. You catch the frame held a beat too long or the overlay that sits slightly off. This is the most important quality in the role.

Self-sufficiency with assets. You can take a script and go find the images it needs without being handed a folder. This is weighted as heavily as your editing.

Willingness to go the extra step. Reviewing your own export once more and fixing what wasn't flagged.

Strong English comprehension. Understanding is essential; polished speaking and writing is a bonus.

Responsive communication. When I message during working hours, I need a reply promptly rather than the following day.

Exclusivity. This is a full-time position and I'm looking for someone working with me only — no other clients, agencies, or subcontracting. In return you get stability, a real salary, and an employer invested in your growth.

A long-term outlook. I'm hiring someone to grow with my content over years, not to fill a short-term gap.



This role likely isn't the right fit if you're applying broadly today, prefer briefs explained in detail more than once, or intend to use AI to write your application answers — I'm looking for your own thinking.



REQUIREMENTS

Proven experience editing short-form vertical video (TikTok / Reels / Shorts)

CapCut or any software you work quickly in — the output is what matters

Confident sourcing your own images, screenshots, and reference material online, with good taste in what looks right on screen

Reliable internet and a computer that handles daily editing without issues

Available full time, with reasonable overlap with my hours. The volume moves with the content schedule — some weeks run 4–5 days, others run 6–7. I need someone who can flex with it rather than hold to a fixed number of days

Able to receive payment via Wise

Comfortable receiving direct feedback and applying it the first time



PAY AND GROWTH



$1,000 USD/month paid through Wise, with potential for performance bonuses. The ceiling on this role sits well above the starting salary — as you learn my style and begin contributing your own ideas, your compensation grows accordingly. You'd be working directly with me each day on videos that have proven to get millions of views.



HOW TO APPLY



Subject line: EDITOR — [number of the example video above you think is hardest to edit] (For example: EDITOR — 2. Applications that don't follow this format won't be reviewed.)



Please include in your message:



Links to 2–3 short-form videos you personally edited, and what you handled on each. If you worked on only part of a video, please say so — accuracy matters more to me than scope.

In your own words, 3–5 sentences, without AI assistance: watch example #3 and describe one editing choice that worked well and one you would have approached differently. There's no right answer — I'm interested in how you evaluate a video.

The software you use and how long you've worked in it.

Your internet speed (a speed test screenshot is ideal) and your typical available hours in PH time.

One sentence on your current work and why you're looking to move.



Paid test — $25 USD. Applicants completing the paid test will use the Google Drive folder linked below, which contains the reference video, original voiceover take, raw footage, and further directions. You'll stitch together the strongest takes, match footage to the voiceover, and send back your version. Note that the folder deliberately does not contain every image the script calls for — part of the test is sourcing a few visuals yourself and placing them where you feel they could belong. It should take about an hour. This test is paid $25 USD regardless of the hiring outcome — I don't ask anyone to work unpaid.



Google Drive (reference video and source files): 



A strong test is followed by a short call, and then a start date. I review every application that follows the instructions above.

title: AI CRE Specialist
description:
AI Implementation Specialist

Commercial Real Estate Investment Sales

Location: Miami, FL (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract / Part-Time

Reports To: ASMW Group



About Us

Current Real Estate Advisors is a commercial real estate investment sales firm specializing in development, retail, office, and flex. We're looking to modernize how we generate leads, communicate with prospects, produce marketing materials, and run our back office — and we need a hands-on AI and automation expert to build it with us.



The Role

We're hiring an AI Implementation Specialist to design and build an integrated AI ecosystem across our sales, marketing, and deal-execution workflows. This is not a theoretical or advisory role — you'll be the person actually connecting the platforms, configuring the bots, training the models on our content, and making sure everything talks to everything else. You'll work directly with ownership and our brokerage team to identify bottlenecks and replace them with AI-driven systems.



What You'll Do

• AI Voice/Sales Outreach: Implement and configure AI-powered outbound calling systems (e.g., AI SDR/voice agents) to qualify and engage investment sales leads at scale.

• Lead Capture Bots: Build and deploy AI chat/help bots for our website and other channels to capture, qualify, and route inbound leads into our CRM automatically.

• Marketing Automation: Use AI tools to generate property marketing flyers, brochures, and
 campaign content — on-brand, accurate, and ready to send with minimal manual editing.

• Offering Memorandums (OMs): Develop an AI-assisted workflow to produce polished, finalized Offering Memorandums in PDF format, pulling from property data, financials, and market comps.

• Platform Integration: Connect and automate workflows across our CRM, Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint), and Adobe products (Acrobat, Photoshop, Creative Cloud), so data and content flow between systems without manual re-entry.

• AI Platform Connectivity: Evaluate, select, and integrate AI tools/APIs (e.g., ChatGPT/Claude, voice AI providers, automation platforms like Zapier/Make/n8n) into a cohesive tech stack tailored to our business.

• Ongoing Optimization: Monitor performance of AI tools, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve prompts, workflows, and integrations as our needs evolve.

• Training & Documentation: Train brokers and staff on new AI tools, and document workflows so systems are maintainable and scalable.



What We're Looking For

• Proven experience building or implementing AI/automation solutions in a business setting (real estate experience a plus, not required).

• Hands-on experience with AI voice/calling platforms, chatbot builders, and AI content generation tools.

• Strong working knowledge of CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, or industry-specific CRE CRMs) and how to integrate them with third-party tools via APIs or automation platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar).

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 and Adobe Creative/Document Cloud products, including automation/scripting where applicable.

• Experience with large language model APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and prompt engineering.

• Comfortable working independently, prioritizing multiple projects, and communicating technical concepts to a non-technical team.



Nice to Have

• Experience with document automation for real estate (OMs, flyers, comp sets).

• Background in AI marketing automation or graphic design workflows.

• Familiarity with commercial real estate data sources (CoStar, Crexi, etc.).



Why Join Us

• Ground-floor opportunity to build an AI infrastructure from scratch at a growing brokerage.

• Direct access to ownership and real decision-making authority over tools and workflows.

• Competitive compensation based on experience [add salary range/structure].



How to Apply

Send your resume and a brief summary of AI/automation projects you've implemented through here.

title: Google Ads Specialist / Paid Ads
description:
Job Title: Paid Ads Specialist (PPC & Meta Ads)

Remote · Contract



About the Role

Trailzi is looking for a Paid Ads Specialist who views digital advertising as both a science and an art. You understand that a great ad campaign isn't just about spending a budget—it’s about engineering a path from a stranger’s curiosity to a client’s conversion.



This isn't a role for someone who simply "sets and forgets" campaigns. We need a data-driven strategist who lives in the metrics but writes with empathy. You will be responsible for building, managing, and scaling paid campaigns across search and social platforms, ensuring every dollar spent works toward a measurable ROI for our clients.



We’re looking for a specialist with a "performance-first" philosophy. While we embrace AI for bidding optimizations and data analysis at Trailzi, we require a human expert who can craft strategy, understand psychological triggers, and pivot based on real-world market shifts. We value proactive thinkers who treat client budgets as if they were their own.



What You’ll Do

- Full-Funnel Campaign Management: Build and manage end-to-end campaigns on Google Ads (Search, Display, PMax) and Meta Ads 
/Instagram).

- Strategic Copy & Creative Direction: Write high-converting ad copy and collaborate with designers to develop visual assets that stop the scroll and drive clicks.

- Advanced Optimization: Perform daily bid management, audience refinement, and A/B split testing to lower CPA and increase ROAS.

- Tracking & Attribution: Ensure pixel tracking, GTM tags, and conversion events are firing correctly to provide 100% transparent reporting.

- Performance Audits: Analyze existing accounts to identify "leaks" in the funnel and implement immediate improvements for new and incoming clients.

- Thoughtful AI Integration: Leverage machine learning and automated bidding strategies where appropriate, while maintaining manual control over brand safety and high-level strategy.



What We’re Looking For

1. Platform Expertise: Proven track record managing five-figure monthly spends across Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.

2. Data Literacy: The ability to look at a spreadsheet of raw data and translate it into a clear, actionable story for a small business owner.

3. Conversion Focus: A deep understanding of landing page optimization and the "post-click" experience—you know that the ad is only half the battle.

4. Technical Proficiency: Comfortable with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and looker studio reporting. Experience with platforms like LinkedIn Ads or TikTok Ads is a plus.

5. Remote Professionalism: Self-motivated, communicative, and reliable in a 100% remote, contractor-based environment.



About Trailzi

Trailzi is a dynamic, results-driven marketing agency dedicated to helping small businesses find real marketing success. We believe the first step to growth is having a clear plan—so businesses can focus their budget on activities that generate measurable results.



We pride ourselves on innovation, leading through the AI revolution, client success, and team collaboration. While our team is made up of contractors, we value long-term relationships, growth in responsibility, and people who want to do meaningful work over time.



Hiring Process

- Submit your resume and a portfolio/case studies showing past campaign performance (ROAS/CPA metrics).

- Selected candidates complete a digital interview by recording video responses.

- Qualified candidates complete a paid "Campaign Strategy" project (payment upon completion).

- Finalists participate in a live interview for the final decision.



How to Apply

1. When you submit your application, please use 5 Apply Points and put the word Trailzi in the subject line.

2. We can’t wait to see how your strategies can help our clients dominate their market and scale their growth.

title: Brand Consultant for a Private Individual To Join A Small Team– Senior, Part-Time, Long-Term, Top-of-Market Pay
description:
The problem



A small, careful group of people are making one of the biggest decisions of their lives, and they make it almost entirely on trust built through text:
 groups, Reddit, a couple of niche platforms, and DMs. Most of the alternatives they're comparing me against are either slick and untrustworthy or trustworthy and invisible. I'm the second kind. I have the substance (a long, candid profile; documented evidence; a track record; references) and the operational side is in good hands: inquiries get answered, documents go out, follow-ups happen on time. That part works, the person running it is staying, and I'm not looking to change any of it. It's what frees this role to be purely about the brand.



What's missing is the layer above it: someone who takes a private individual with real credibility and makes him the obvious, memorable, trusted choice in a skeptical community, without a hint of salesmanship, because salesmanship is exactly what this audience has learned to distrust.



The full context is personal and shared on a first call, then under NDA. It's legal and ethical. It's also sensitive, so if that's not for you, no hard feelings.



What the job actually is



Positioning first: find the one thing that makes me the safe choice and build everything around it. Then the whole surface: a one-page site, a document packet people forward to their partner and their lawyer, photo direction, and post and message copy tuned to how each community reads, screenshots, and compares notes. Then the machine: where to show up, how often, how to respond so that reply rate stays high and the spam filter stays quiet, and a playbook clear enough that the person already running the day-to-day can execute it without you in the loop. You'd own the brand and the strategy; the execution stays with the person who already handles it, and part of your job is making her more effective, not doing her work. To be clear, this is an addition, not a replacement: I'm building this role around the people I already have. Think of it as consulting with real ownership: your judgment, their hands, my time when you need it.



Who I'm looking for



Someone who has done this before for a person, not a product: a consultant, a physician, a founder, a candidate, anyone whose whole business was being trusted by strangers online. You write with precision and restraint; you know that in a high-stakes decision, one overclaiming sentence undoes ten honest ones. You have a feel for community dynamics that can't be faked, and you're the sort of person who'd rather cut a paragraph than add one. Discretion is non-negotiable.



I don't care about your follower count, your agency, or your certifications. I care whether you can look at what I have and see what it should become.



The filter



Don't send a proposal. Send one paragraph answering this: a person is choosing between two strangers for something irreversible. Both are qualified. One writes beautifully; the other shares every document up front. Who wins, and what does the winner's first message look like? Under 150 words. Start with the word "baseline." If your answer is good, I'll book a call, we'll sign an NDA, and I'll pay you for a one-page critique of my current profile. That critique is the interview.

title: Meta Media Buyer + AI Creative (Gig / Part Time) for Lead Gen Co
description:
Read the whole post before applying. There are 4 questions at the bottom and I only reply to people who answer them.



ABOUT US

We run two things. A pay per lead business that sells exclusive leads to personal injury law firms across the US, and a marketing agency serving medical and dental practices. Both run on Meta ads.



THE ROLE

You own Meta creative and campaigns end to end.



All of our creative is AI generated. I supply the tools, the credits (Nano Banana Pro and similar) and the creative direction. You take that direction and:



- Generate the AI statics and video yourself

- Ideate angles, hooks and offer framing off my direction, not just execute a brief

- Build and launch the campaigns in Meta

- Monitor daily and optimize on CPL, lead quality and booked appointments, not just cheap clicks

- Work with our GoHighLevel person on pixel, CAPI and tracking



WHAT WE PAY

$10/hour, gig work or part time, roughly 10 to 20 hours a week. I would rather pay per project or per defined scope than buy hours, so tell me how you would price it.



This is not a full time seat. Please do not apply if you need 40 hours a week.



WHAT I ACTUALLY CARE ABOUT

Not your tool list. I care whether you can look at an offer, come up with angles that make someone stop scrolling, and then produce the creative yourself. If your process is to write a brief and wait on a designer, this is not the role.



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years running Meta lead gen campaigns you can show real numbers for

- You generate AI creative yourself, image and ideally video

- Comfortable with Meta Pixel and Conversions API

- GoHighLevel experience, or able to work alongside someone who has it

- Some overlap with US business hours



NICE TO HAVE

- Legal, personal injury or law firm lead gen

- Medical or dental lead gen

- Short form video editing



HOW TO APPLY

Put BROADSIDE at the top of your message so I know you read this, then answer these four:



1. Have you generated ad creative with AI image or video tools yourself? Which ones, and link me something you actually made.



2. Pick an offer you have never worked on and walk me through how you would come up with angles and hooks for it.



3. How comfortable are you with GoHighLevel, Meta pixel and CAPI?



4. Your availability, and how you would want to be paid for gig work.



If your answers make sense I will send you a small paid test task. Our tools, one real offer, three statics and three hooks plus the campaign structure you would launch with. Paid either way, whether or not we end up working together.



No worries at all if this is not your thing. Thanks for reading.



Tom

title: Project Cordinator
description:
Project Coordinator – Residential Construction



Full-Time | Remote 



About the Role



Dreamville Homes is a Sydney-based residential construction company specialising in custom homes.



We are looking for an experienced, organised and proactive Project Coordinator to support our Project Manager and construction team with the day-to-day coordination and administration of residential building projects.



This is a long-term, full-time position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of tasks, follow up outstanding items and keep projects organised without requiring constant supervision.



Key Responsibilities



Project Coordination



Assist the Project Manager with day-to-day project activities.

Coordinate with trades, subcontractors, suppliers, consultants and internal staff.

Follow up outstanding tasks, quotations, documents and information.

Maintain project task lists and ensure outstanding items are followed through.

Coordinate information between the office, site team, trades and consultants.



Quotes & Procurement



Send requests for quotations to trades and suppliers.

Follow up quotations and supplier pricing.

Compare quotes, including price, scope, inclusions and exclusions.

Prepare quote comparison summaries for management.

Assist with procurement and ordering.

Maintain accurate records of trade and supplier pricing.



Invoice Processing



Receive and process supplier and subcontractor invoices.

Check invoices against approved quotations, purchase orders and agreed pricing.

Identify pricing or scope discrepancies.

Allocate invoices to the correct project.

Prepare invoices for management approval.

Maintain accurate invoice and cost records.



Drawings & Approvals



Coordinate architectural, structural, engineering and consultant drawings.

Follow up consultants for outstanding drawings and revisions.

Maintain drawing registers and ensure current revisions are correctly recorded.

Assist with preparing and collecting documentation required for Council, CDC, certifier and other approvals.

Follow up outstanding approval requirements.

Maintain organised records of approvals, certificates and project documentation.



Inspection Coordination



Book construction inspections with certifiers and consultants.

Coordinate inspection timing with the Project Manager and Site Supervisor.

Follow up inspection reports.

Maintain records of inspections, reports and certificates.

Follow up outstanding documentation or rectification items where required.



Administration & Record Keeping



Maintain organised electronic project files.

Keep accurate records of trades and suppliers.

Maintain quote, invoice, inspection and document registers.

Prepare
s, letters, spreadsheets and other project documentation.

Assist with meeting notes and action lists.

Perform general day-to-day construction administration duties.

Provide administrative support to the Project Manager and management team as required.

Candidate Requirements



We are looking for someone with:



Minimum 3 years of relevant experience.

Previous construction, project coordination or construction administration experience.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong organisational and time-management skills.

Good attention to detail.

Strong Microsoft Excel, Word and general computer skills.

Confidence communicating with trades, suppliers and consultants.

Ability to compare quotations and identify differences in pricing and scope.

Experience processing and checking invoices.

Ability to understand construction terminology and basic construction drawings.

Strong document-control and record-keeping skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

Ability to work independently and take responsibility for assigned tasks.

A proactive attitude – we want someone who follows up outstanding matters rather than waiting to be reminded.



Previous experience working with an Australian residential builder or construction company will be highly regarded.



Experience with Australian construction processes, Council/CDC approvals, private certifiers, architectural drawings and construction management software will also be an advantage.



Working Hours



Full-Time – 40 hours per week



Monday to Friday during Sydney, Australia business hours.



You must be available during our normal working hours to communicate with our Project Managers, office team, trades, suppliers and consultants.



Who We Want



We are looking for someone who can become an important part of our construction team.



You should be comfortable taking responsibility for tasks such as:



A quotation hasn't arrived → follow it up.

Three trades have quoted → compare the quotes and prepare a summary.

An invoice doesn't match the approved quote → identify and report the discrepancy.

A consultant hasn't provided a drawing → follow it up.

Documentation is missing for an approval → identify what is outstanding and coordinate it.

An inspection is required → organise and book it.

A Project Manager has outstanding actions → help coordinate and follow them through.



The objective of this position is to reduce the administrative workload of our Project Manager and help keep our projects organised and moving efficiently.



How to Apply



Please send:



Your resume.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

Details of your construction/project coordination experience.

Details of any previous experience working with Australian construction companies.

Software and systems you have used.

A brief explanation of your experience with quote comparison, invoice processing and construction documentation.

A 2-minute video introduction explaining your experience and why you believe you would be suitable for this role.



Please start your application with:



“DREAMVILLE PROJECT COORDINATOR”



Applications without this phrase may not be considered.



We are looking for someone interested in a stable, long-term position with the opportunity to grow with Dreamville Homes.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
# About the Role



We're looking for a sharp, detail-oriented **Graphic Designer** to create graphics for social media and potentially merchandise. Your single objective: turn ideas and concepts into engaging, polished designs that stand out and feel native to social media.



We provide the direction, concepts, and brand assets. Your job is to bring them to life — creating social media graphics, promotional assets, campaign designs, and other visual content.



As the role grows, there may also be opportunities to help design merchandise, including apparel, accessories, and other physical products.



No specific industry experience required. Griffin will personally train you on the style we're looking for and what makes our content perform. What we can't teach is attention to detail and follow-through — bring that.



# Responsibilities



Create graphics for Instagram and other social platforms



Design social posts, stories, promotional graphics, and campaign assets



Turn rough ideas and references into polished designs



Create engaging designs that grab attention and fit naturally on social media



Follow our established visual style and brand direction



Create reusable templates for social content



Make revisions based on feedback



Potentially design merchandise, apparel, and other physical products



Prepare print-ready files when needed



Keep design files and finished assets organized



Deliver completed designs consistently and on time



# Requirements



1+ years of graphic design experience, ideally creating content for social media



Strong understanding of Instagram and current social media design trends



Excellent visual taste and attention to detail



Highly organized and reliable



Able to take creative direction and incorporate feedback



Able to take a rough concept or reference and turn it into a finished design



Proficient with Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Canva, or similar design software



# Success Looks Like



Consistent delivery of completed designs



Creative that looks polished and grabs attention



A recognizable and consistent visual style



Reliable turnaround times with minimal revisions



Ability to take an idea and execute it without needing excessive direction



# How to Apply



Answer all of the questions below, in order, in your application. Applications that skip questions or ignore instructions will not be reviewed.



# Screening Questions



1. What is your favorite color?



2. Describe your graphic design experience. What type of work have you designed and who have you designed for?



3. Roughly how many social media graphics or other design assets have you created in a typical week?



4. Walk us through how you would take a rough idea or reference and turn it into a finished social media graphic.



5. Begin your answer to this question with your answer to Question 1. Then tell us: what design software do you use, and how do you keep your projects and files organized?



# Required Design Sample



Send a link to your portfolio and **3 examples of social media graphics or other designs you have personally created.**



Then, in one or two sentences, explain what you did on those designs and why you made the creative choices you did.



If you have experience designing **merchandise, apparel, or physical products**, please include examples of that work as well.

title: Medical Doctor (MD Degree Required) - Remote Doctor's Assistant, Camera On, Full Time
description:
MEDICAL DOCTOR (MD) WORKING AS REMOTE DOCTOR'S ASSISTANT - FULL TIME, CAMERA ON



PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST CAREFULLY BEFORE YOU APPLY.



IMPORTANT: This position is ONLY for applicants who hold a Doctor of Medicine degree. You will not be practicing medicine or treating patients. You will be working as a doctor's assistant supporting a US-based medical office. Applicants who are not medical doctors will not be considered.



We are a US-based medical office looking for a professional, reliable, English-fluent medical doctor to work remotely as our doctor's assistant. This is a long-term, full-time position on US Pacific Time hours, 50 hours per week.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATION

- Doctor of Medicine (MD) degree from an accredited medical school. You must be able to provide your diploma and supporting documents.

- This is a hard requirement. Nursing, medical assistant, caregiver, and allied health backgrounds do not qualify.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Support the doctor with clinical documentation and chart preparation

- Review patient information and summarize histories for the doctor

- Answer inbound patient calls and return messages promptly

- Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments

- Patient intake: collect and enter demographic and insurance information

- Verify insurance eligibility and benefits

- Manage the office inbox and respond to patient inquiries

- Maintain accurate records in the practice's EMR/EHR system

- Handle reminder calls, follow-ups, and no-show rescheduling

- Other administrative and clinical support tasks as assigned



NOTE ON SCOPE: You will work under the direction of a licensed US physician. You will not diagnose, prescribe, or provide medical advice to patients.



EQUIPMENT AND POWER REQUIREMENTS

- Reliable computer and a quality headset

- Stable high-speed internet, plus a BACKUP INTERNET connection

- MANDATORY BACKUP BATTERY: You must have a backup battery, UPS, or portable power station for your home office. If the electricity in your area is disconnected, you must still be able to work and stay on camera. Applicants without backup power will not be considered.



OTHER REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent spoken and written English - clear and easy to understand, comfortable on the phone with US patients all day

- Familiarity with EMR/EHR systems and strong command of medical terminology

- Able to work US Pacific Time business hours, 50 hours per week

- HIPAA awareness and complete discretion with patient information



PROFESSIONAL APPEARANCE AND CAMERA REQUIREMENTS

- This is a camera-on remote position.

- You must have a clean, organized, and professional office setup.

- Your background must always be neat, appropriate, and professional during working hours.

- You must remain available on camera when required during your shift.

- You are expected to wear clean, professional business attire while working.

- Your overall appearance and workspace should reflect the standards of a professional medical office.

- Your camera, microphone, lighting, internet connection, and workspace may be reviewed before employment.



SELECTION PROCESS

- There will be MULTIPLE INTERVIEWS conducted by live video call (FaceTime, Zoom, or similar). You must be able to appear on camera for each one.

- Before you begin working with our office, you will complete a TEST OF PUNCTUALITY AND PROFESSIONALISM. This includes showing up on time, on camera, properly dressed, in a clean workspace.

- Your medical degree will be verified.

- Only apply if you are fully comfortable with all of the above.



COMPENSATION

$1,000 - $2,000 USD per month, depending on experience. Full time, 50 hours per week. Long-term position with room to grow.



HOW TO APPLY

Please reply with:

1. Your resume / CV

2. A copy or photo of your Doctor of Medicine diploma

3. A short voice or video recording introducing yourself in English (30-60 seconds)

4. A photo of your actual work-from-home workspace

5. A photo of your backup battery / UPS / power station

6. A screenshot of your internet speed test

7. Your earliest available start date

8. Your salary expectation



Applications without proof of a medical degree and a voice or video sample will not be considered.

title: REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS CLOSER
