title: Senior Engineer (React/Node, GCP/Cloudflare), AI-native, long-term. Read the first paragraph before you apply.
description:
Senior Engineer (React/Node, GCP/Cloudflare), AI-native, long-term. Read the first lines before you apply.



IF YOU CAN'T SOLVE BASIC systemdesign io PROBLEMS, DO NOT APPLY. I WILL THROW A SYSTEM DESIGN EXERCISE AT YOU DURING THE INTERVIEW, AND WE WILL BOTH LOSE TIME IF YOU CAN'T SOLVE IT. 



This is not a formality. The URL shortener is the floor. If you can only solve the "easy" problems, this role is not for you. My last round of interviews was full of people who could not reason through a basic system, so I am being blunt on purpose.



WHO I AM

I am a senior developer and CTO running a small high-end dev agency. I only take serious, high-stakes work. No WordPress, no throwaway projects. Full remote, building for clients all over the world. This role is not customer-facing: you work directly with me, I deal with the clients. I want someone long-term who becomes part of the company and builds something real with me, done properly, never rushed or half-baked.



THE ROLE, DAY TO DAY

- Fully AI-driven. Your day is orchestrating AI agents (Claude, Codex, and similar), reading and reviewing their code, and holding the line on quality, including blocking a merge when the output is not good enough. You are not hand-writing everything.

- Building genuinely cool things and going deep on automation.

- Stack is mostly React and Node, plus GCP and Cloudflare.



WHAT I ACTUALLY NEED (this is the job)

- System design. You can take requirements and design a database schema, then defend your tradeoffs. You reason about concurrency: race conditions, locking, idempotency, what happens when two requests land at the same time. You can architect a system end to end: caching, cache invalidation, failure modes, blast radius, and what breaks when traffic goes 10x.

- Real infra and cloud: GCP, Cloudflare, CI/CD, deployments.

- You can sketch an architecture live in Excalidraw. It takes two minutes to learn. If you do not know it, learn it before we talk.

- You drive AI agents every day and review their output with a critical eye.

- Fluent English, reliable, autonomous.



SETUP

- Full remote, full time. Work whenever you want, as long as the work gets done.

- $2,500/month, plus I pay for your Claude Code Max plan.

- Your own machine for now. We can look at hardware later.

- Long-term, with room to grow and become part of the company.



HOW TO APPLY

No cover letter, I do not read them. Send a link to a short video, 3 to 5 minutes:

2. Pick one system-design problem (a URL shortener, or a read-heavy news site serving millions of reads a day) and walk me through your design while sketching it in Excalidraw: the database schema, how you handle concurrency, what you cache and how you invalidate it, and what breaks at scale. Keep it extremely simple.



Keep it real, not scripted. If you send a CV or a generic AI-written message with no system-design walkthrough, I will not reply.



I INSIST:

*** IF YOU CAN'T SOLVE BASIC systemdesign io PROBLEMS, DO NOT APPLY. I WILL THROW A SYSTEM DESIGN EXERCISE AT YOU DURING THE INTERVIEW, AND WE WILL BOTH LOSE TIME IF YOU CAN'T SOLVE IT. ***



If you don't know basic HTTP codes, concurrency, locking, cache, load balancing and hashing techniques, this job is NOT for you.

title: (Muslim) Short-Form Video Editor - With Fulltime vision
description:
Content Editor — Awrah Movement

We are looking for a skilled Content Editor to join our team on a full-time basis.

Awrah Movement is a Muslim-owned athletic wear brand. We make performance base layers designed for men who want to train without compromising on their modesty. Our audience is Muslim men who take both their training and their deen seriously.

Your main responsibility will be turning the raw content we deliver — phone footage, athlete clips, product shots — into polished videos and visuals that perform on Instagram, TikTok and paid ads.

You should be highly comfortable with short-form video editing and have a strong eye for pacing, detail and brand consistency.

Your tasks will include:

 • Editing raw footage into short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok and paid ads

 • Cutting and pacing content so it holds attention in the first three seconds

 • Adding captions, subtitles and text overlays in our brand style

 • Colour correction and clean-up of raw footage

 • Creating static visuals and ad creatives from our product photography

 • Adapting content to multiple formats (9:16, 4:5, 1:1)

 • Working consistently within our brand guidelines: colours, typography and tone

 • Delivering a steady volume of content on schedule

Working within our values

We are a Muslim brand, and our content reflects that. This shapes how we edit:

 • We do not use music in our content. We work with sound design, voiceover and natural audio.

 • All imagery is modest. Models are always fully covered.

 • Our tone is respectful and purposeful — never crude or provocative.

You should be comfortable working within these guidelines and understand why they matter to the people we serve. Familiarity with the Muslim community and its sensibilities is a strong advantage: it helps you judge what will land and what will not, without needing to ask.

Requirements:

 • Strong experience with video editing software (Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve or similar)

 • Proven experience editing short-form content for social media

 • Good understanding of pacing, hooks and retention

 • Comfortable with basic graphic design and text animation

 • Excellent attention to detail and consistency

 • Able to follow detailed brand guidelines and workflows

 • Able to work independently and meet deadlines

 • Good English communication skills

 • Experience with paid social ad creative is a strong advantage

You do not need to be a videographer or a designer from scratch. We are primarily looking for someone who is very skilled at taking raw material and making it land.

Full-time | Remote

title: Mechanical/Structural Engineer (Senior Level Experience)
description:
Basepoint Engineering



About Us

At Basepoint Engineering, we design and certify custom lifting equipment and structural solutions built to the highest safety standards, including ASME B30.20. Our expertise covers below-the-hook lifting devices, spreader beams, attachments, and structural components like stairs, platforms, and walkways.

We're a nimble, remote-first Canadian engineering team providing full-cycle services, from conceptual design and load analysis to 3D/2D modeling (SolidWorks, Onshape), FEA, and manufacturing support. Our mission is to deliver practical, innovative, and safe solutions for clients who rely on precision lifting and structural systems.



The Role

We're looking for a Mechanical/Structural Engineer to join our growing team. You'll work on custom lifting devices and structural projects, collaborating with field teams and supporting the full engineering lifecycle, from design and analysis to fabrication support.

What You'll Do

• Design custom lifting devices and attachments compliant with ASME B30.20

• Develop 3D models and 2D drawings in SolidWorks and/or Onshape

• Perform load analysis and finite element analysis (FEA)

• Support reverse engineering and field-based design solutions

• Collaborate with manufacturing teams to ensure build accuracy

• Contribute to projects involving stairs, platforms, and walkways



What We're Looking For

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, or related field

• Proficiency in SolidWorks and/or Onshape

• Strong understanding of load analysis, structural integrity, and safety standards

• Experience with FEA (asset)

• Familiarity with ASME B30.20 (or willingness to learn)

• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

• Comfortable working independently in a remote-first environment

• History of heavy industry steel-related manufacturing

• History of computational engineering, including free-body diagrams and calculations for determining the capacity of steel structures



Selection Process

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will be required to complete and pass a technical aptitude assessment. This assessment is designed to evaluate fundamental engineering knowledge, problem-solving ability, computational engineering skills, free-body diagram development, structural analysis, and engineering calculations related to steel structures and lifting equipment. Successful candidates will demonstrate strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to develop safe, practical, and code-compliant solutions.



Why Join Us

You'll work directly with an experienced senior engineer on real, high-impact projects, starting with smaller designs and scaling up as we grow together. We value flexibility, learning, and collaboration in a supportive, remote-first environment.

If you're ready to apply your mechanical and structural expertise to meaningful, hands-on engineering projects, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Sales Rep (Setter + Closer) — US Clients, Hourly + Commission
description:
We're hiring one salesperson to own an entire pipeline end to end.



This is not a "just book appointments" job and it's not a "we hand you warm leads" job. You find the leads, you book the calls, you run the calls, you close the deals. If you like owning a number and being paid for what you close, this is a good fit. If you only want to do one half of that, this isn't the role.



WHO YOU'D BE SELLING FOR

You'd be placed with one US company we work with, selling their service to small and mid-sized businesses across the US. We'll tell you exactly who they are, what the offer is, and what the average deal size is on the first interview — we just don't put our clients' names in public job ads.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build your own prospect list (we'll show you the ICP and where they hang out)

- Cold outreach:
, LinkedIn, DMs, and phone — whatever gets a reply

- Follow up 5–7 times. Most deals live in follow-up #4.

- Book discovery calls on your own calendar

- Run the call: qualify, present the offer, handle objections

- Close, or set a firm next step. No "let me think about it" without a date.

- Keep the CRM current — every touch logged, every deal in a real stage

- Show up to a short weekly pipeline review



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 2+ years in sales with a real closing component. Tell us what you closed.

- Near-native spoken English. You'll be on the phone with US business owners.

- You've done cold outreach and you're not scared of the phone

- Comfortable being measured on activity and on closed revenue

- Organized enough to run a pipeline without someone reminding you

- Reliable internet, a quiet space, a good headset, and a working webcam



BONUS POINTS

- You've sold to US small business owners before

- You've sold software, marketing services, or anything with a monthly retainer

- You've used a CRM properly (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Close, Pipedrive)



WHAT IT PAYS

- $3–4/hour base depending on experience, paid twice a month via Wise — you get paid while you ramp

- Plus commission on every deal you close. We set the exact percentage on the interview once you know the offer and the deal size, so we can agree on a number that's fair for both of us.

- Full hourly for your first 30 days while you learn the offer

- Commission is paid once the client's first invoice clears. If a client refunds within 30 days, the commission comes back — that's the only catch, and we'd rather tell you now than surprise you later.

- If you're good, the commission is the bigger half of your income. That's the point of the role.



THE SETUP

- Full-time, 40 hrs/week, with at least 4 hours overlapping 9am–5pm US Central

- You're placed with one company and you own that pipeline. Not a call center, not a rotation, not five accounts at once.

- Hiring is run by Rico Automations on the company's behalf. We screen, they d
.



HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ

We delete applications that skip these. It's the fastest way for us to find people who actually read.

1. Start your message with the word CLOSER.

2. Tell us about the last deal you closed: what you sold, deal size, how you first reached that person, and how many touches it took.

3. Record a 90-second video doing a cold pitch — pick any product or service you've sold before and pitch us like we're a US business owner hearing it for the first time. It doesn't need to be perfect, we want to hear how you sound and how you handle it. Send us the link.

4. Answer: You send 100 cold
s and get 2 replies. What do you change first?



We reply to every application that follows these steps, within 3 days, either way.

title: Full-Time Online Homeschool Learning Coach — 4th & 7th Grade (U.S./Florida Curriculum + Catch-Up Support)
description:
About the Position



We are looking for a reliable, patient, and experienced Full-Time Online Homeschool Learning Coach to work with two children studying through a U.S./Florida online homeschool program.



Student 1: 4th Grade

Student 2: 7th Grade



Both students need additional academic support because they are catching up after missing approximately one school year.



This is not a traditional one-hour tutoring position. We are looking for one dedicated person who will work with the children consistently Monday through Friday and help manage their daily online education.



Responsibilities



You will:



Work online with both students Monday through Friday

Help them follow their daily online school schedule

Sit with them virtually while they complete lessons and assignments

Explain lessons they do not understand

Assist with Math, English/Language Arts, Science, and Social Studies

Review homework and assignments before submission

Make sure assignments, quizzes, and required schoolwork are completed on time

Track each student's academic progress

Identify gaps in their knowledge from the previous school year

Create additional catch-up exercises when necessary

Give extra attention to Math, Reading, Writing, and other weak areas

Help the students develop good study habits, independence, and organization

Keep the children focused and engaged during school hours

Provide parents with a short daily update and a more detailed weekly progress report

Main Goal



Our goal is not only for the students to successfully complete 4th Grade and 7th Grade, but also to close as many academic gaps as possible so they can gradually catch up to their appropriate grade level.



The Learning Coach should be able to balance:



Current Schoolwork + Catch-Up Work + Academic Progress



Requirements



We are looking for someone who:



Has excellent spoken and written English

Has experience teaching or tutoring children

Is comfortable with the U.S. K–12 curriculum

Can confidently teach elementary and middle-school subjects

Is especially strong in Math and English

Can explain difficult concepts in a simple way

Is patient, positive, organized, and dependable

Can manage two students at different grade levels

Has a reliable computer, high-speed internet, webcam, and quiet working environment

Is comfortable using Zoom/Google Meet and online learning platforms

Can commit to a consistent Monday–Friday schedule



Experience with U.S. homeschooling, Florida curriculum, Common Core, online schools, or American students is strongly preferred.



Schedule



Monday–Friday



Approximately 4–5 hours per day



This is intended to be a long-term position, not temporary tutoring.



Exact working hours will be discussed during the interview.



What We Expect



We want someone who will take responsibility for the children's daily academic routine.



You should not simply give them answers or complete assignments for them. Your job is to teach, explain, supervise, motivate, and make sure they understand the material.



We are looking for someone who can become their consistent teacher, mentor, and learning coach throughout the school year.

description:

title: Weekend Home Care Recruiter
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based home care company looking for an experienced, dependable Recruiter to join our team as an independent contractor. This position is specifically designed to provide recruiting coverage Friday through Sunday and keep our caregiver hiring pipeline moving throughout the weekend.



This is not an entry-level recruiting position. We are looking for someone who already understands recruiting, is comfortable communicating with U.S.-based applicants, and can work independently with minimal supervision.



## Schedule



Friday, Saturday & Sunday



Specific working hours will be established based on business needs and applicant activity. Some availability during U.S. Central Time hours is required.



This is a contract position.



## Primary Responsibilities



You will be responsible for managing weekend recruiting activity, including:



* Reviewing new caregiver applications and resumes

* Quickly contacting qualified applicants

* Conducting initial phone/video screenings and interviews

* Following up with candidates already in the recruiting pipeline

* Moving qualified applicants through the hiring process

* Maintaining accurate applicant notes and statuses

* Assisting candidates with completing required onboarding steps and documentation

* Identifying strong candidates who are ready for next steps with our weekday team

* Maintaining consistent communication with management regarding recruiting activity and candidate progress

* Helping ensure promising applicants are not lost simply because they applied over the weekend



Our goal is simple: when a qualified caregiver applies Friday evening, Saturday, or Sunday, we do not want them waiting until Monday to hear from us.



## Required Qualifications



* Previous professional recruiting experience

* Experience recruiting for U.S.-based companies

* Strong candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, and follow-up skills

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Comfortable conducting phone and/or video interviews

* Highly organized and detail-oriented

* Able to work independently and manage your workload without constant supervision

* Reliable internet connection and a professional, quiet working environment

* Comfortable learning and working within multiple recruiting and onboarding systems



## Strongly Preferred



Experience recruiting caregivers or other employees within the U.S. home care, home health, healthcare, or senior care industries is strongly preferred.



Previous experience with any of the following is a significant advantage:



* Augusta

* Home Care Pro

* WellSky

* Indeed or other U.S. recruiting platforms

* Caregiver onboarding and compliance processes



Candidates with direct experience using Augusta and/or Home Care Pro are strongly encouraged to apply.



## What We're Looking For



We want someone who understands that successful recruiting requires urgency and follow-through.



You should be comfortable picking up the recruiting process where our weekday team leaves off on Friday and keeping candidates engaged throughout the weekend. We need someone who takes ownership, follows up consistently, communicates professionally, and understands that strong caregiver candidates can be lost when response times are too slow.



## To Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. Your resume

2. A brief description of your recruiting experience

3. Your experience recruiting for U.S. home care, healthcare, or similar companies

4. Whether you have used Augusta, Home Care Pro, WellSky, or similar systems

5. Your availability Friday through Sunday

6. Your desired hourly rate

7. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your recruiting experience



Please begin your application with the words "WEEKEND RECRUITER" so we know you carefully read the entire posting.



We are looking for someone dependable who can become an important extension of our recruiting team and help us maintain recruiting momentum seven days a week.

Applications that skip these steps get deleted, so please don't skip them.

I read every application that follows the steps and reply within 3 days either way.

title: GoHighLevel Specialist (GHL Specialist)
description:
# GoHighLevel Freelancer – Advanced CRM & Automation Setup for Spa



We are looking for an experienced GoHighLevel freelancer to build and configure GoHighLevel for our growing spa business.



We are looking for someone who can design and implement the system end-to-end, including integrations, automations, reporting and data flows — not simply configure basic pipelines and
 sequences.



### Requirements



* Minimum 4 years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience

* Strong experience building complex GoHighLevel systems from scratch

* Strong understanding of webhooks, APIs and third-party integrations

* Experience connecting Meta/Facebook Ads with GoHighLevel

* Experience building advanced workflows and CRM architecture

* Experience creating meaningful CRM and marketing reporting

* Experience integrating external booking systems

* Ability to troubleshoot integrations independently

* Excellent attention to detail

* Able to explain technical concepts clearly

* Experience with spas, salons, clinics, aesthetics, hospitality or other appointment-based businesses is strongly preferred



### Scope of work



You will be responsible for:



* Structuring our GoHighLevel CRM and customer database

* Building lead and customer pipelines

* Connecting our website and lead sources to GHL

* Connecting our Meta/Facebook advertising account and ensuring lead/ad data flows correctly into the CRM

* Building integrations using webhooks, APIs, Zapier/Make and native GHL integrations where appropriate

* Connecting our external booking system to GHL

* Creating sophisticated workflows for leads, bookings, cancellations, rescheduling, completed appointments and no-shows

 communication

* Creating customer segmentation using tags, custom fields and workflow logic

* Creating reporting dashboards to track the full customer journey from lead → booking → attendance → treatment → repeat booking/revenue

* Setting up attribution/reporting to understand which marketing campaigns and lead sources generate actual customers and revenue

* Troubleshooting integration and automation issues

* Testing the complete system before launch

* Providing documentation and basic training for our team



### Technical screening questions



1. Webhooks / API / Data Architecture



We use several different systems, including our website, booking system, Meta Ads and messaging platforms. We want customer and appointment information to move between these systems and GoHighLevel reliably.

Specifically, explain how you would prevent duplicate contacts, handle an existing customer booking again, update an existing contact when appointment information changes, and deal with failed or duplicated webhook events.

3. Describe the most technically complex GoHighLevel implementation you have personally built. What systems were integrated, what did you build yourself, and what was the final outcome?



4. Have you previously implemented GoHighLevel for a spa, salon, clinic, aesthetics business or another appointment-based business where the system needed to track the customer journey from lead through appointment and ultimately revenue? If yes, describe the setup and reporting you built.

* Examples of 2–3 comparable GHL projects

* Which integrations you personally implemented

* Your availability

title: Digital Asset Acquisition Specialist (Online Communities)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're a small digital media company that grows and manages niche online communities, and we're looking for a sharp deal-maker to acquire them for us. If you've flipped domains or websites, brokered digital assets, or done partnership or acquisition outreach, this is squarely in your wheelhouse. The assets here are Reddit communities — but the core job is the one you already know: find the owner, judge what the asset is worth, reach out, and close the deal. We'll get you up to speed on the Reddit-specific mechanics; we can't teach the judgment and the deal instinct, so that's what we're hiring for.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Work from a list of candidate communities you generate from our in-house software app, and d
 which are actually worth pursuing

• Judge each asset's real value — niche fit, engagement quality, and commercial/search potential — not just its surface numbers

• Find and reach the owner/moderator across the appropriate channels (including their public social profiles) and open the conversation

• Negotiate and close the acquisition — moderation or ownership transfer

• Handle the handoff — coordinating the transfer once a deal is struck

• Run a clean pipeline: targets, outreach, deals, and spend



WHAT WE'RE ACTUALLY HIRING FOR

Two things, in this order:

1. Judgment. Anyone can pull traffic numbers. The rare skill is looking at a community and knowing whether it's genuinely valuable and worth the money — the right niche, real search/monetization potential — without us weighing in on every call.

2. Deal-making. Cold outreach to a stranger, opening the conversation, negotiating value, and closing cleanly. This is most of the job, day to day.



Reddit familiarity is a plus, but it is NOT the requirement — the mechanics (how moderation and transfers work) are quick to learn for the right person. Don't skip applying because you're not a "Reddit person."



COMPENSATION 

Competitive base salary + bonus structure  



WHO YOU PROBABLY ARE

• A domain or website flipper, digital-asset broker, or someone who's done acquisition/partnership outreach and negotiation

• You have real commercial judgment — you can size up an asset's value fast and be right

• You're comfortable cold-reaching strangers and closing deals

• You're highly organized and self-directed — you own your pipeline with minimal oversight

• Clear written English

• Bonus (not required): Reddit, affiliate, or SEO experience



TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE

1. Tell me about a deal you sourced and closed — a domain, website, digital asset, partnership, whatever. How did you find it, how did you value it, and how did you close it?

2. When you're sizing up an online asset (a site, a community, a domain), what tells you it's genuinely valuable and worth paying for versus something that just looks big on the surface? Be specific.

3. You need to acquire something from an owner who isn't actively selling. Walk me through how you'd reach them and open a negotiation.

4. Your desired salary.

title: Remote Intake Specialist – Remote Philippines
description:
Position Summary

As Remote Intake Specialist at Ready2Nurse, you cover the front of our patient workflow on off-hours (Saturdays, Sundays, and evenings). Hospitals discharge patients seven days a week; you make sure referrals that arrive on the weekends or evenings get a fast, professional response, move toward Acceptance, and land cleanly with the weekday team on Monday. You also support our clinicians remotely during their weekend visits, assembling referral packets, coordinating starts of care, handling scheduling changes. Since we are a small company, you will also support other roles and assist as needed in all areas of patient care coordination. This is a remote, part-time or full-time role worked on a California daytime schedule.

Qualifications:

Required

• Fluent, excellent spoken and written English; this is a hard requirement. You will be on the phone with US patients, families, hospital discharge planners, and physician offices, and you must represent us flawlessly

• At least 3+ year’s experience supporting US Home Health agency, specifically with intake

• Warm, persuasive phone presence: able to win the confidence of patients and referral sources in the first call and build relationships that last 

• Hands-on insurance eligibility and prior authorization experience: running Medicare eligibility, checking commercial coverage through Availity or payer portals, recognizing when authorization required, and initiating and tracking auth requests

• Excellent organization skills - ability to track and manage multiple patients at various stages of intake, and work fast under deadlines. 

• Able to work Saturday and Sunday on a California daytime schedule, reliably and independently



Preferred

• Proficient with Kinsser/Wellsky EHR

• Clinical degree or background (RN, PT, LVN, etc) 

• Familiarity with hospital referral portals (AIDA, Careport)

• OASIS Expertise and knowledge of Home Health regulations

Job Duties:

Referral Intake

• You will primarily be responsible for “winning” patients who have contacted us initially – getting patients from initial phone call, fax, or
, through intake “acceptance” and start of care.

• Continuously monitor and respond to our various intake channels – hospital portals, fax,
 & phone inquiries – and respond within 1 hour. 

• Screen referrals for service area, clinical fit, and clinician capacity, and verify insurance eligibility (Medicare and Commercial) using Availity or other online portals; escalate questionable cases to leadership. 

• Follow up with hospitals and physician offices for required documentation (face-to-face notes, home health orders, etc.).

• Complete outbound calls to win new referrals and develop referral relationships. 

Care Coordination

• Coordinate weekend starts of care with on-call clinicians and patients: complete referral packets, complete pre-charting, order wound care supplies, etc. 

• Manage weekend inbound calls from existing patients, regarding cancellations, schedule changes, and other issues; escalate to Administrator when needed. 

• Assist with any other areas of patient care coordination when needed, such as QA, Billing, Schedule Management, etc. 

Compensation & Schedule

• Compensation: ₱435 to ₱625/hr ($7-10/hr) depending on qualifications

• Schedule: Part-time or Full-time. 16-40 hours per week, with availability on Saturday and Sunday during CA business hours. 

About Us

Founded in 2018, Ready2Nurse is a 5-Star Medicare-rated concierge home health agency ranked in the top 5% nationwide. We provide compassionate, customized care that helps seniors age safely and comfortably at home. MD-owned and clinically led, we combine advanced medical insight with hands-on leadership, recently strengthened by a partnership with experienced operators who have built and scaled organizations across health care. Unlike franchise agencies, we operate independently, so our clinicians can prioritize quality care and meaningful patient relationships.

Why Join

• Mission-driven and clinician-led, focused on quality outcomes and excellent patient-care.

• A young, entrepreneurial company growing fast, with new ventures, new markets, and real room to grow with us and expand into leadership roles. 

• Technology-forward: we invest in modern tools so the work keeps getting smarter

• A flat organization where leaders work right next to you and your ideas shape the company’s direction

• A supportive, collaborative culture with ongoing mentorship and professional development

description:
Social Media & Marketing Manager – Real Estate



Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term



Mitchell Properties is looking for an experienced Social Media & Marketing Manager to manage the social media and digital marketing for an established Texas real estate business.



This is NOT an entry-level position and is not a project-based content creation role.



I am looking for someone who understands marketing AND social media and has previous experience working directly with a real estate professional or real estate business.



REAL ESTATE EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must have previous, ongoing experience managing social media and/or marketing for a:



Realtor or Real Estate Broker

Real Estate Team or Brokerage

Property Management Company

Home Builder

Or another real-estate-related business



You must be able to prove this experience and provide examples of business accounts you personally managed.



Managing your own Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, or personal brand does not qualify.



Completing occasional graphics, videos, or one-time projects for real estate clients does not qualify.



I am looking for someone who has actually been responsible for managing another person's or company's business marketing and social media on an ongoing basis.



ABOUT THE POSITION



I am a full-time Texas Real Estate Broker actively selling homes and working with buyers, sellers, relocation clients, listings, and past clients.



The purpose of this position is not simply to “post on social media.”



I need someone who understands how to use social media and marketing to support and grow a real estate business.



You will be responsible for helping manage the overall marketing and social media presence of Mitchell Properties, including creating and implementing marketing strategies, managing content, creating and editing social media content, marketing real estate listings, repurposing existing content, monitoring performance, and bringing new ideas and recommendations to the business.



I am looking for someone who can take ownership of this area of the business.



I do not want to have to tell you every day what needs to be posted or what marketing needs to be done. You should be able to look at what is happening in the business, recognize marketing opportunities, develop ideas, and execute them.



I also do not want a social media strategy that requires me to become a full-time content creator. I am a Realtor first. Social media and marketing should support the real estate business—not become the business.



QUALIFICATIONS



You should have:



Proven professional social media and marketing experience

Previous ongoing real estate marketing experience

Experience managing social media for someone else's business

Strong marketing and strategic thinking skills

Strong written and spoken English

Excellent communication skills

Strong attention to detail

Social media content creation and video editing skills

Experience analyzing social media performance

Ability to work independently and take initiative

Ability to manage deadlines and priorities

Ability to learn and maintain an established brand voice

Ability to communicate ideas and make recommendations instead of simply waiting for instructions



Experience with platforms and tools such as Instagram,
, LinkedIn, Canva, CapCut, Flodesk, Google Workspace, Trello, and AI tools is beneficial.



HOURS



This is a long-term, part-time position.



Approximately 15–20 hours per week to start.



You must have some availability during U.S. Central Time business hours for communication and collaboration.



HOW TO APPLY



 your application to:







Your
 subject line MUST be:



ONLINEJOBS.PH – PINK SOCIAL – Social Media & Marketing Manager – [YOUR NAME]



Please tell me about your professional social media and marketing experience and specifically about your real estate experience.



Your application should include:



The real estate businesses/professionals you have worked with

How long you managed each account/business

What you personally were responsible for

Examples of your actual work

Results you achieved, when available

Your current weekly availability

title: Email Marketing & Client Database Manager
description:
Change Craft is a Sacramento-based strategic communications firm serving government agencies, nonprofits, businesses, and political campaigns across California. We are a certified small business and minority-owned business, known for our work in issue advocacy, coalition building, multicultural and LGBTQ+ community strategy, public health communications, and political and public affairs campaigns. We don't just consult; we connect, collaborate, and create alongside our clients and the communities they serve.



We are looking for an
 Marketing & Client Database Manager to own the outreach infrastructure that powers our clients' advocacy, engagement, and public affairs campaigns. Because we work across multiple clients and campaigns at once, including government agencies, nonprofits, coalitions, and political efforts, this role requires someone who can keep several outreach programs, contact databases, and
 calendars organized simultaneously without losing the thread on any one of them. You will manage our HubSpot CRM and Mailchimp
 platform, run day-to-day outreach campaigns on behalf of clients and coalitions, and make sure our contact data stays clean, segmented, and ready to mobilize, whether that's a legislative alert, a coalition action, a nonprofit newsletter, or a paid outreach push.



What You'll Do



Plan, build, and execute
 campaigns across multiple client and coalition accounts (advocacy alerts, newsletters, fundraising and mobilization asks, event promotion, nurture sequences) in Mailchimp

Manage and maintain HubSpot CRM records across client and coalition contact lists, keeping data accurate, current, and properly segmented by client, issue, and audience

Own ongoing outreach programs from planning through execution, tracking, and follow-up, coordinating with account leads on timing and messaging

Build and maintain distinct lists, segments, and tags for each client or coalition to ensure the right message reaches the right audience, including multicultural and LGBTQ+ community-specific segments

Monitor and report on
 performance (opens, clicks, conversions, unsubscribes) by client and campaign, and translate results into recommendations for account teams

Maintain data hygiene across HubSpot and Mailchimp: deduplicating records, correcting formatting, merging duplicate client lists, and archiving stale contacts

Manage data sync and integrations between HubSpot, Mailchimp, and other tools used across accounts

Ensure compliance with
 marketing and political communications regulations (CAN-SPAM, CASL, and applicable state and political disclosure requirements)

Partner with account leads and consultants to align outreach with each client's broader advocacy, public affairs, or communications strategy

A/B test subject lines, content, and send times to optimize engagement across diverse audiences

Maintain documentation for
 workflows, database structure, and client-specific processes

What We're Looking For



2+ years of experience in
 marketing, CRM or database management, or a related role; agency, nonprofit, government affairs, or political experience is a strong plus

Hands-on experience with HubSpot and Mailchimp (or comparable platforms)

Comfort managing multiple accounts, lists, and campaigns simultaneously without losing organization

Strong understanding of
 marketing best practices, deliverability, and audience segmentation

Detail-oriented, with the judgment to handle sensitive or politically nuanced contact data appropriately

Familiarity with, or willingness to learn, compliance rules specific to nonprofit, government, and political
 communications

Excellent written communication skills and comfort adapting tone across clients and audiences

Genuine interest in advocacy, public affairs, or community-focused work

Nice to Have



Experience supporting political campaigns, advocacy coalitions, or nonprofit membership programs

Familiarity with multicultural and LGBTQ+ community engagement or outreach strategy

Basic HTML/CSS skills for
 template customization

Experience with reporting dashboards (HubSpot reporting, Google Data Studio/Looker Studio)

What Success Looks Like



Clean, well-segmented, up-to-date contact databases across all client and coalition accounts

On-brand, on-time
 campaigns that hit engagement benchmarks for each client

Reliable outreach infrastructure that account leads can trust to mobilize audiences quickly when a campaign needs it

Its growth focus is clear: help more parents discover the right programme, book a diagnostic consultation or trial, and receive a thoughtful follow-up experience.



Role overview

- The SEO & SEM Specialist will own the search roadmap for Achievers Dream. This is a hands-on role covering technical SEO, local SEO, Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), content optimisation, Google Ads, landing-page conversion and performance reporting.



You will work closely with the management, content and web teams to make sure Achievers Dream is visible when Singapore parents search for Primary Science tuition, PSLE Science tuition, O-Level Chemistry tuition, JC H2 Chemistry tuition, Chemistry practical tuition and local tuition options near its centres.



The role is not just about traffic or clicks. It is about building a reliable search engine that produces qualified parent enquiries, trial bookings and measurable learning-programme demand.



What you will do



SEO strategy and execution

- Build and maintain an SEO roadmap for Achievers Dream's core programmes: Primary Science, PSLE Science, Lower Secondary Science, O-Level Chemistry, IP Chemistry, JC H1/H2 Chemistry and Chemistry practical lessons.

- Carry out keyword research, search-intent mapping and competitor analysis for the Singapore tuition market.

- Optimise service pages, location pages, resource hubs, blog content, titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links and calls to action.

- Improve local SEO visibility for Lorong Chuan, Bukit Timah and Kembangan, including Google Business Profile hygiene, location-page content and review signals.

- Work with the web team on technical SEO: crawlability, page speed, Core Web Vitals, redirects, canonicals, structured data, mobile UX and site migrations.

- Build content briefs that help parents and students, while improving eligibility for search results and AI-assisted search experiences.

- Own GEO and AEO improvements so Achievers Dream is easier to understand, cite and recommend across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other answer engines, using clear entity information, helpful FAQs, structured content and accurate on-page proof.

- Monitor rankings, organic traffic, indexed pages, technical issues and AI-search visibility; translate findings into a prioritised monthly action plan.



Google Ads and paid-search performance

- Build, manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns for Achievers Dream's programmes and locations.

- Structure campaigns by intent and level, for example: Primary Science, PSLE Science, O-Level Chemistry, JC H2 Chemistry, Chemistry Lab and local branch terms.

- Write and test search ads, assets, landing-page messages, audience signals, keyword match types and negative-keyword lists.

- Improve qualified leads by monitoring search terms, conversion quality, cost per lead, cost per booked trial and campaign-level performance.

- Run disciplined A/B tests across ads, landing pages, offers,- forms, calls to action and bidding strategies.

- Coordinate retargeting and paid social support where it is part of the approved campaign plan.

- Protect budget quality by excluding irrelevant searches such as free notes, tutor jobs, answer keys and non-target education levels where appropriate.



Analytics, reporting and conversion tracking

- Maintain reliable tracking across Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and lead or trial-booking forms.

- Define and report the conversion journey from click to enquiry, booked trial, attendance and enrolment where CRM data is available.

- Build a simple monthly dashboard for management covering organic visibility, paid spend, qualified enquiries, cost per lead, conversion rate, booked trials and key actions taken.

- Diagnose drops or anomalies before making recommendations; clearly distinguish confirmed first-party results from platform estimates.

- Use Ahrefs, Google Ads Keyword Planner, Google Search Console, GA4, Looker Studio and crawling tools to guide decisions.



Collaboration and ownership

- Work directly with management, teachers, content writers and developers to turn search insights into better pages, campaigns and parent journeys.

- Maintain a clear backlog of SEO, SEM, content and technical actions, including owner, priority, expected impact and validation method.

- Keep up with Google Ads policy changes, search algorithm updates, local-search behaviour and AI-assisted search trends.

- Bring practical recommendations, not just reports. Explain what should change, why it matters, who owns it and how success will be measured.



What we are looking for



Required

- 3+ years of hands-on SEO and Google Ads experience.

- Proven ability to manage search campaigns that generate leads, not just clicks.

- Strong technical SEO knowledge: site architecture, redirects, canonicals, indexation, page speed, Core Web Vitals, schema and internal linking.

- Strong Google Ads experience across search campaigns, keyword strategy, bidding, search-term analysis, conversion tracking and landing-page optimisation.

- Comfort using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Ahrefs, Looker Studio and spreadsheet-based analysis.

- Strong written English and the ability to write clear, parent-friendly search ads, briefs and reporting summaries.

- Analytical discipline: can explain the difference between a ranking, a click, an enquiry, a booked trial and an enrolled student.

- Organised, proactive and comfortable working independently in a remote team.



Strongly preferred

- Experience in Singapore local SEO, education, tuition, enrichment, healthcare or another parent-led local-service market.

- Experience optimising Google Business Profiles and multi-location local search.

- Experience working with WordPress, Astro or another modern CMS.

- Familiarity with CRM or lead-management workflows and offline conversion tracking.

- Experience producing or briefing educational content for Primary, PSLE, O-Level or JC audiences.

- Experience with GEO, AEO, AI-search visibility, entity optimisation or structured content for answer engines.



First 90 days

| Period | Focus | Expected output |

| Days 1 to 30 | Audit and foundation | Access and tracking review, SEO, GEO/AEO and Google Ads audit, keyword map, priority opportunity list, lead-quality baseline and 90-day execution plan. |

| Days 31 to 60 | Launch and optimise | Rebuilt or improved campaign structure, negative-keyword controls, priority landing-page improvements, local SEO actions and first content or technical tickets shipped. |

| Days 61 to 90 | Scale what works | Documented test learnings, conversion-quality review, a prioritised next-quarter roadmap and a management dashboard with agreed reporting definitions. |



KPIs for success



KPIs will be agreed after access, tracking and baseline data are verified. Likely measures include:

- Growth in qualified parent enquiries and booked trials from organic and paid search.

- Improvement in cost per qualified lead and cost per booked trial, where tracking is reliable.

- Visibility and ranking progress for agreed commercial keywords across Primary Science, PSLE Science, O-Level Chemistry, JC Chemistry and local branch terms.

- Organic clicks, impressions and conversion contribution from Google Search Console and GA4.

- Google Ads search-term quality, click-through rate, conversion rate and budget efficiency.

- Completion of agreed technical, content and landing-page priorities.

- Clear monthly reporting with recommendations, owners and follow-up actions.



Application process



Before submitting your resume, please include a concise 90-day draft plan for how you would improve Achievers Dream's SEO, GEO/AEO and Google Ads performance. This can be a one- to two-page document. We are looking for clear priorities, practical actions and how you would measure progress, not a generic proposal.



Please submit:



1. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

2. Your 90-day draft plan, submitted together with your resume.

3. A short summary of one SEO project and one Google Ads project you personally improved.

4. A sample dashboard, report or case study, with sensitive client data removed.

5. A short response to this question: How would you approach improving qualified trial bookings for a Singapore Primary Science and Chemistry tuition centre in your first 90 days?



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid practical assessment based on an anonymised Achievers Dream landing page or Google Ads account scenario.

title: Paid Media Buyer – Meta & Google (E-commerce Focus)
description:
BEFORE YOU APPLY — KNOCKOUTS (must be YES)

1. Are you willing to work over 40 hours a week? YES

2. Are you willing to work over the weekend? YES

3. Are you completely fluent in English (written and spoken)? YES



# Paid Media Buyer – Meta & Google (E-commerce Focus)

**Connect Social · Full-time · Remote (Worldwide) · Mid–Senior**



Connect Social is a performance marketing partner for e-commerce and DTC brands. We've worked with 120+ brands across subscription, established DTC, celebrity/creator, and high-stakes niches including politics. We run paid media,
/SMS, CRO, creative, and influencer under one roof — which means the media buyer here isn't handed a black box. You see the whole funnel, and you're accountable for what happens in it.



We're hiring one senior Paid Media Buyer. Location is open globally. English must be completely fluent (written and spoken). This is a high-output remote seat: we expect people who can sustain **40+ hours/week** and are **willing to work weekends** when accounts or launches need it. If that is not a hard yes, do not apply.



## Before you apply — answer these (must be YES to both)

1. Are you willing to work over 40 hours a week?

2. Are you willing to work over the weekend?



If either answer is no, this role is not a fit. Applications that do not confirm both will be declined.



## What you will own

- Full ownership of a book of e-commerce accounts on Meta and Google — strategy, build, launch, optimization, and the number at the end of the month

- Media planning and budget allocation across platforms, tied to blended targets, not in-platform vanity metrics

- Structured creative testing: writing briefs, reading results, and telling our creative team what to make next based on data — not taste

- Feed and Shopping health on the Google side, including PMax, brand/non-brand separation, and search term hygiene

- Measurement integrity: CAPI, server-side tracking, and reconciling platform-reported numbers against actual business results

- Client-facing reporting and calls — presenting performance, defending decisions, and telling a founder the truth when a month goes sideways

- Diagnosing accounts that are underperforming and having a specific point of view on why, backed by evidence



## Non-negotiable qualifications

Read this section carefully. If you don't clear these bars, this role isn't the right fit.



- **English:** Completely fluent in English (written and spoken). Client calls and Slack are in English.

- **Hours:** Willing and able to work **40+ hours/week** and **weekends** when needed. Overlap with US Eastern business hours for client calls is required.

- **Scale:** You've personally managed at least $5M+ in lifetime ad spend, or you're currently running $200K+/month sustained across your book of accounts. Not agency-wide spend you were adjacent to — spend you had your hands in.

- **Tenure:** 3+ years buying media specifically for e-commerce/DTC. Lead gen, B2B, and app install experience is fine as a supplement, but it isn't a substitute.

- **Both platforms:** Deep, current, hands-on experience in both Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. Not "I've dabbled in Google." We need someone who can build a PMax campaign and fix a broken product feed without escalating it.

- **Business math:** You're fluent in blended ROAS, MER, contribution margin, CAC, AOV, and LTV. You understand why a 2.1x in-platform ROAS can be a great month or a disaster depending on the P&L, and you can explain which one it is.

- **Measurement:** You've implemented or overseen server-side tracking and CAPI. You've worked with a third-party attribution tool (Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar) and you know where those numbers lie.

- **Creative literacy:** You can look at 40 ads and tell us which 3 to scale, which 5 to iterate, and why. You understand that creative is the primary targeting lever, and you can brief it clearly.

- **Receipts:** You can walk us through specific accounts you've scaled — starting point, ending point, what you changed, and what you'd do differently. Real numbers, real timelines.

- **Setup:** Reliable high-speed internet, quiet space for client calls, and your own computer capable of running Ads Manager / Sheets / Meet without friction.



## You'll stand out if you have

- Experience navigating ad account restrictions, policy appeals, and compliance-sensitive verticals

- TikTok and/or Truth Social buying experience

- Experience running incrementality or geo-lift testing

- You've taken an account from healthy to great and pulled one back from the edge — both skills, not just one



## The mentality we are hiring for

Skills can be taught. This part can't.



**You figure it out.** When you hit something you've never seen before — a new platform update, a tracking break, an account structure you didn't build — your first instinct is to go find the answer, not to ask who's handling it. You'll have support here and you'll never be left stranded, but you should be the kind of person who shows up to the conversation with a hypothesis already formed.



**You're a perfectionist about your output.** Nothing leaves your hands that you're not proud to put your name on. No typos in ad copy. No mismatched UTMs. No report with a number that doesn't tie out. If it's 90% done, it's not done, and you know the difference between the two without being told.



**Your attention to detail is uncomfortable.** You're the person who notices the landing page headline doesn't match the ad, catches the duplicated audience exclusion, and spots the $400 spending in a paused-but-not-really-paused ad set. Small things compound in this job. Missing them costs real money.



**You're relentlessly curious.** You're reading changelogs, testing things in your own accounts, and following what's actually working right now — not what worked in 2023. This industry rewrites itself every six months and you find that energizing rather than exhausting.



**You own the outcome.** When a campaign underperforms, you show up with the diagnosis and the plan before anyone asks. You don't hide behind the algorithm, iOS, or a bad creative cycle. You also speak up early when something isn't working — bad news travels fast here, and that's by design.



**You operate independently.** We're remote. Nobody is watching your calendar. You manage your own priorities, hit your own deadlines, and communicate proactively enough that no one has to chase you for a status update.



**You care about the client's business, not just the account.** Our clients aren't campaign IDs. Your success is measured by whether their business grew — and we treat their success as our own.



## How to apply

1. Confirm in your application / cover note that you answer **YES** to both: (a) willing to work 40+ hours/week, and (b) willing to work weekends.

2. Include your LinkedIn (or portfolio), location/timezone, and 2–3 account receipts (spend scale + outcomes — anonymized is fine).

3. Apply through the board where you found this post.

title: Part-Time Ecommerce Customer Support & Retention Specialist (USA HOURS)
description:
# Part-Time Ecommerce Customer Support & Retention Specialist



**Location:** Remote — Philippines

**Schedule:** Part-Time initially, working during U.S. business hours

**Growth Path:** Expected to transition to full-time quickly after training and ramp-up



## About the Role



We are a fast-growing U.S.-based ecommerce company looking for a highly reliable, thoughtful, and customer-focused **Customer Support & Retention Specialist**.



This is not a basic copy-and-paste customer service position.



Customer service is extremely important to our business, and we are looking for someone who can communicate professionally, solve problems, calm frustrated customers, and make good decisions while protecting both the customer relationship and the business.



You will work closely with the owner during your initial training period and will be given clear SOPs, templates, and guidance.



This role will begin **part-time only temporarily** while you learn our systems, policies, products, and customer service standards. Once you are fully trained, comfortable handling cases, and able to work independently, we expect the position to **transition into a full-time role quickly**.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow into a long-term position with the company.



## Responsibilities



You will help manage customer support across our ecommerce business, including:



* Responding to customer
s

* Answering inbound customer phone calls

* Making outbound calls when necessary

* Responding to shipping and tracking questions

* Investigating delayed or unusual shipments

* Handling return and refund requests

* Offering appropriate solutions to retain customers when possible

* Coordinating replacements and reshipments

* Handling damaged, incorrect, or missing-item cases

* De-escalating frustrated customers professionally

* Following company return, refund, and retention procedures

* Keeping accurate notes on customer cases

* Escalating unusual or high-risk situations to the owner

* Following up with customers until cases are fully resolved



During the training period, you will work closely with the owner and can escalate situations whenever you are unsure rather than guessing.



As you become more experienced, you will gradually be given more responsibility and authority to resolve customer cases independently.



## What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate:



* Has excellent written English

* Speaks clear, confident, professional English

* Is comfortable talking directly with U.S. customers on the phone

* Has previous customer service or ecommerce experience

* Is calm when dealing with upset or demanding customers

* Has strong judgment and problem-solving skills

* Can follow SOPs carefully without sounding robotic

* Understands that issuing a refund is not always the first or best solution

* Is comfortable offering alternatives such as replacements, reshipments, or partial refunds when appropriate

* Pays close attention to order details, tracking information, and previous customer communication

* Is organized and documents their work carefully

* Is reliable during scheduled U.S. working hours

* Takes ownership of problems instead of simply passing them along

* Is interested in growing into a larger, long-term role with the company



Experience with **Shopify** is strongly preferred.



Experience with ecommerce fulfillment, tracking systems, chargebacks, returns, refunds, or customer retention is a major plus.



## What Success Looks Like



We do not measure good customer service simply by how quickly tickets are closed.



A successful person in this role will:



* Keep customers informed and reassured

* Resolve issues without unnecessary refunds

* Save sales when a reasonable solution exists

* Prevent avoidable chargebacks

* Catch shipping or fulfillment problems early

* Maintain fast response times

* Communicate naturally rather than sending robotic responses

* Make thoughtful decisions

* Know when to resolve something independently and when to escalate it



Customer support is an important part of the revenue and reputation of the business, so we are looking for someone who takes the role seriously.



## Schedule & Growth



This position will **start part-time for training and ramp-up purposes only**.



The part-time period is intended to give you time to learn:



* Our customer service standards

* Our policies and SOPs

* Our products

* Our shipping and fulfillment processes

* How we handle refunds and returns

* How we approach customer retention

* When to escalate situations



Once you are fully trained and consistently handling cases correctly, the position is expected to **move to full-time quickly**.



Candidates should therefore be interested in and available for a future full-time schedule.



You must also be comfortable working hours that overlap with normal U.S. business hours.



## Compensation



Competitive hourly compensation based on experience.



There will also be opportunities for **performance-based bonuses** for consistently strong work.



We want someone who cares about customer experience, protects the business, and grows with the company, and strong performance will be rewarded accordingly.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your previous customer service or ecommerce experience.

2. Whether you have worked with Shopify before.

3. Whether you have handled returns, refunds, shipping problems, or angry customers.

4. Your experience answering U.S. customer phone calls.

5. Your available working hours in U.S. Central Time.

6. Your expected hourly rate.

7. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you think you would be a good fit for this position.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted long-term member of the team and grow into a full-time role as quickly as they are ready.

title: Amazon Growth Lead / General Manager
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established e-commerce business growing brands on Amazon, with strong in-house capability across operations, advertising, and listing optimisation. We are ready for the next stage of growth and want a senior operator to lead it.

We are looking for a senior Amazon growth expert who can spot the gains we miss from the inside and bring expertise beyond what we have today.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role.



This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon PPC Strategy (core)

– Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps

– Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs

– Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats

– Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

– Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth

– Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation

– Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role



Listing Optimisation (core)

– Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

– Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content

– Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

– Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact

– Keep listing and PPC strategy working together



Systems & Reporting

– Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance

– Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers

– Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner

– Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce



Operations & Team Leadership

– Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches

– Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment

– Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions

– Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding

– Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

– 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience

– Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios

– Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

– Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency

– Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures

– Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment

– Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

– Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious

– Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding

– Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain

– Experience managing people and coordinating across functions

– Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why



STRONG ADVANTAGES

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio-level budget allocation

9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

You will do well if you:

1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities

2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it

4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change

6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



WORKING DAYS AND HOURS

– Full-time – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

– Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

– 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Please apply with the following. Applications without these will be less considered.

– Your CV/Resume

– A short video introduction of yourself and why you're a good fit

– A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

– Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

– The approximate monthly advertising spend and number of ASINs you have handled

– Why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing before this application

description:
You'll collaborate with me, a content creator, on my YouTube channels by providing illustrations and graphics that complement and enhance mostly "faceless" long-form videos (explainer, listicle, and on occasion, vlog-style videos). The channels focus on entertaining, educational topics. You'll help grow the channel audience and engagement by crafting visually stimulating illustrations that are both easy-to-grasp, yet also reflect a unique visual style consistent with the channel brand.



What's expected of you:



• good English and communication skills



• meet a standard of quality under deadline within a busy production schedule



For example, for a 5 minute faceless explainer video, I may ask you to produce an illustration that visually reinforces or enhances the voiceover narrative content for every 5 to 15 seconds of the video. So that would be a total of about 30 illustrations for the 1 video. We'd establish together a reasonable deadline for producing those 30 illustrations. I'll handle video ideation, scripting, voiceover recording, editing and publication.



The more efficient you are (we both are), the more videos we can publish per week, and the faster the channel(s) will grow. We'll find a pace that's workable for both of us. I don't want you to rush or burn out. Yet I also want us to keep up with an effective publishing schedule.

• freedom to choose the design applications you like to use (for example, Illustrator, Photoshop or Procreate). You'll be submitting work in standard formats for incorporating them into videos during editing phase (for example, compressed JPG or PNG files).



These illustrations will be sketches—mostly black & white, grayscale or using a simple color palette—not super-detailed masterpieces. Think cartoons, doodles, or simple line drawings. Their purpose is to illustrate the idea or point being made at a given juncture in the narrative. Speed is more important than perfection.



• I'm less interested in how much experience you have and more interested in your commitment to grow as an artist and collaborator. I value creativity, reliability, a willingness to take ownership of your work, and the drive to learn.



What you can expect from me:



• clear guidelines on what to produce

•  the chance to express your unique artistic style

• openness to your ideas and suggestions—I see this as a collaboration

• an open door policy when it comes to discussing concerns or problems—no need to disappear if something worries you

• encouragement—detail-specific praise for quality work, as well as constructive notes on changes needing to be made. I'm a former professor who's taught ESL and literature in Asia. I take pride in being a supportive coach. I want you to succeed, and I'll do my best to help you do so.

13th month
