title: Burnout & Sustainable Performance Sales Advisor
description:
# Burnout & Sustainable Performance Sales Advisor



**Part-Time | 10 Hours/Week Initially | $2/Hour + High Commission**



We are looking for an experienced **B2B Sales Advisor** who can develop relationships with business leaders, conduct consultative sales conversations, and close professional-services engagements.



This is not an appointment-setting role.



You will own opportunities from initial outreach through paid-client handoff.



## What You Will Sell



### Burnout & Sustainable Performance Operating Review



A focused **3-week, $9,500 professional-services engagement** that helps leadership teams identify what is driving burnout and unsustainable pressure, determine what needs to change, and build a practical 90-day action plan.



Our core client proposition is:



**We help leaders identify what is driving burnout, reduce the pressures they can control, and build a 90-day plan for healthier, more sustainable performance.**



Within three weeks, the leadership team will know:



* the 3 to 5 biggest sources of unsustainable pressure contributing to burnout

* what needs to be stopped, reduced, redesigned, or protected

* which leadership actions will have the greatest impact

* who owns each action

* what should happen over the next 90 days



The buyer is purchasing a structured organizational diagnosis, leadership alignment, and practical action plan.



This is not a wellness program or resilience training.



## Who You Will Sell To



Potential buyers include:



* CHROs and Chief People Officers

* Heads of Talent or Leadership Development

* Business Unit Executives

* Transformation Leaders

* PMO and Enterprise Delivery Leaders

* COOs

* Directors, Senior Directors, and VPs responsible for high-pressure teams, functions, or business units



Our initial focus is typically a contained leadership team, department, function, transformation team, PMO, or business unit rather than an enterprise-wide engagement.



## What You Will Own



You are responsible for moving opportunities through the entire sales process.



Responsibilities include:



* reviewing prospects provided to help build your pipeline

* identifying and developing additional opportunities

* conducting personalized B2B outreach

* building relationships with senior decision-makers

* qualifying business need, urgency, authority, and fit

* conducting consultative sales conversations

* clearly explaining the Burnout & Sustainable Performance Operating Review

* handling objections professionally

* maintaining disciplined follow-up

* progressing qualified opportunities through the pipeline

* closing the $9,500 engagement

* securing client payment

* handing the paid client to the Founder for delivery



The Founder delivers the engagement after the sale.



**You are responsible for closing the business.**



Prospects will be provided to help build your pipeline. Advisors are also expected to develop additional opportunities through their own research, relationships, referrals, LinkedIn, and other appropriate B2B channels.



**Advisor-generated opportunities earn a higher commission rate.**



## Compensation



**Base Pay: $2/hour**



### Company-Sourced Prospects



**20% of net collected client revenue**



At the standard $9,500 engagement price, this represents approximately **$1,900 in commission before applicable transaction-specific deductions.**



### Advisor-Sourced Prospects



**25% of net collected client revenue**



At the standard $9,500 engagement price, this represents approximately **$2,375 in commission before applicable transaction-specific deductions.**



Commission is paid on **net collected client revenue**.



Net collected client revenue means client payments actually received, less applicable transaction-specific charges such as payment-processing fees, currency-conversion fees, refunds, chargebacks, and similar direct transaction costs.



Lead source is established when the prospect enters the company lead system.



Company-generated prospects are identified and classified when added to the lead database. Advisor-generated prospects must be submitted and validated before outreach begins.



**Lead source is determined by the earliest validated entry in the lead database.**



## Schedule



**Initial schedule: 10 hours per week, with the opportunity to increase to 15–20 hours per week based on demonstrated performance and pipeline development.**



This role has room to grow for an Advisor who consistently develops pipeline, conducts strong sales conversations, follows up professionally, and closes business.



## DO NOT APPLY Unless You Meet the Criteria



This role is not a fit if your sales experience consists primarily of:



* inbound leads

* customer service

* warm leads only

* appointment setting without closing responsibility

* reading scripts without conducting real sales conversations

* high-volume transactional sales with little interaction with business decision-makers

* relying completely on company-provided leads



We need someone who can confidently sell a sophisticated professional service to business leaders.



## Strong Candidates Will Have



* proven B2B sales experience

* experience developing their own pipeline

* experience selling services, solutions, consulting, or other high-value B2B offerings

* experience communicating with Directors, VPs, executives, or other senior decision-makers

* strong discovery and qualification skills

* excellent written English

* strong spoken English

* disciplined follow-up habits

* professional objection-handling skills

* experience closing business rather than simply setting meetings

* evidence of measurable sales results

* strong professional judgment

* ability to quickly learn a specialized professional-services offering and communicate its value clearly



Experience selling consulting, advisory services, leadership development, HR solutions, organizational development, transformation services, professional services, executive education, or similar B2B offerings is especially relevant.



## Application Questions



Please answer every question. Generic applications will not be considered.



1. How many years of direct B2B sales experience do you have?



2. What products or services have you personally sold?



3. Who were your typical buyers or decision-makers?



4. What was the typical price of the offer you sold?



5. Were you responsible for generating your own leads, working company-provided leads, or both?



6. Describe how you build a prospect list when no leads are provided.



7. Approximately how many outbound prospecting activities did you complete each week?



8. Approximately how many qualified sales conversations did you generate?



9. What percentage of your previous role involved closing versus appointment setting?



10. Describe your strongest example of a B2B sale you personally sourced and closed from beginning to end.



11. What do you say when a prospect tells you, **“Let me think about it”?**



12. What do you do when a prospect expresses interest and then stops responding?



13. How would you approach selling a $9,500 professional-services engagement to a Director, VP, or executive?



14. What evidence can you provide that demonstrates your actual sales performance?



15. Why does this opportunity interest you?



## About the Opportunity



Organizations are under increasing pressure to deliver results while managing workload, competing priorities, organizational change, burnout, and accelerating demands.



The Burnout & Sustainable Performance Operating Review helps leadership teams understand what is creating unsustainable pressure, identify what leadership can change, and take practical action before burnout begins affecting performance, engagement, decision quality, or key talent.



We are building this practice deliberately and are looking for a strong B2B Sales Advisor who wants to help grow the client base, earn meaningful commission, and expand their role as performance is demonstrated.

title: Strategy Manager — Research & Marketing Strategy
description:
Strategy Manager — Research & Marketing Strategy



Remote — Philippines | Full-Time



About the Role



If you are the person who reads three sources when one would do—and cannot let a “because that's how it works in this industry” go unchecked, this role may be for you.



**Rohring Results** is a US-based marketing agency providing **SEO, Google & Meta Ads, social media, content, creative,
 marketing, and web development** for clients across multiple industries.



We are hiring a **Strategy Manager** to own the strategic direction behind our client work.



This is **not a single-channel marketing role**. You will connect research, positioning, SEO, paid advertising, social media, content,
, creative, and web strategy into one coherent plan.



More importantly:



**This is a research job with a strategy title.**



Your job is to find out what is actually true about a market, a buyer, a competitive landscape, and a client's position—and then determine what the client should do about it.



When the research is strong, everything downstream becomes stronger. When the research is shallow, every channel can end up confidently solving the wrong problem.



What You'll Actually Do



1. Lead Client Strategy



You will own the strategy for new clients, including:



* Developing the overall marketing strategy and direction

* Connecting multiple channels into one integrated plan

* Identifying the client's biggest growth opportunities

* Determining what should be prioritized and why

* Translating research into clear strategic recommendations

* Making sure SEO, paid, social, content,
, creative, and web efforts work toward the same objectives



2. Conduct Deep Marketing Research



You will personally conduct or direct research involving:



* Buyer and audience research

* Customer personas

* Competitive analysis

* Industry and market research

* Brand positioning

* Audience research for paid campaigns

* Competitor messaging and offer analysis

* Market trends and opportunities



We are looking for someone who actually **does the research**, not someone who simply delegates it.



You should be able to take a research project, explain your methodology, show your sources, challenge your assumptions, and explain how you determined that your conclusions were reliable.



3. Build Brand Foundations



Many of our clients do not have clearly defined brand guidelines or positioning.



You will help establish:



* Brand positioning

* Differentiation

* Target audience

* Brand voice

* Key messaging

* Value propositions

* Messaging angles



Our copywriters and designers will use these strategic foundations to create the actual deliverables.



**You don't need to be the person writing every headline. You need to know which headline should exist and why.**



4. Review and Approve Content & Creative



You will have real strategic authority over work before it reaches the client.



You will:



* Review content and creative deliverables

* Identify when something does not align with strategy

* Give clear and actionable feedback

* Approve or reject work before client delivery

* Explain *why* something needs to change

* Ensure the final output reflects the research and strategy



You should be comfortable telling someone, including someone who does not report to you, that their work is not ready—and giving them enough direction to fix it.



5. Direct
 Campaign Strategy



You will determine:



* Target audience

* Campaign objective

* Offer

* Messaging angle

* Sequence

* Call to action



Our copywriter will write the
s.



**You provide the strategic brief and approve the final work.**



6. Analyze Client Performance



You will produce and review client performance reports using AI-assisted tools.



But generating a report is only the beginning.



You will need to determine:



* What actually happened?

* Why did it happen?

* Which numbers matter?

* Which numbers are misleading?

* What changed from the previous period?

* What should we do next?

* Does the data actually support the story the report is telling?



We need someone who can **question the report, not just format it.**



---



AI Is a Major Part of This Role



Every agency says it uses AI.



Here's what we actually mean.



Our teams already use AI to draft, research, brainstorm, and refine work. That is not what makes this position different.



**Your job is to be exceptionally good at getting reliable information out of AI tools—and knowing when the information is wrong.**



You will be expected to:



* Frame research questions that produce specific, useful answers rather than generic summaries

* Build effective prompts and research workflows

* Iterate instead of accepting the first response

* Cross-check AI-generated information

* Identify unsupported claims and hallucinations

* Understand what an AI model can and cannot reliably know

* Know when AI should **not** be used

* Use primary sources, customer reviews, forums, sales calls, interviews, analytics, and other sources when appropriate

* Turn research into documented, reusable strategic resources



**Anyone can get an answer from AI. We need someone who can determine whether the answer is actually true.**



During the hiring process, we may assess this skill directly.



If you can describe a time when an AI tool gave you an answer that *looked correct but wasn't*—and explain how you caught it—we want to hear about it.



---



What You'll Own



* Overall marketing strategy for new clients

* Integrated multi-channel strategy

* Market and industry research

* Buyer and audience research

* Competitive analysis

* Brand positioning and differentiation

* Customer personas

* Paid advertising audience strategy

* Content and creative direction

* Content and creative approval

*
 campaign strategy

* Client performance reporting

* Strategic recommendations based on performance data

* Ongoing independent research

* Documentation of research methods and strategic frameworks



Dedicated Research Time



A portion of every week will be protected for **research that is not tied to a specific client**.



This is intentional.



We want someone who actively studies markets, competitors, technology, consumer behavior, marketing trends, and emerging opportunities.



Nobody will necessarily be waiting for the output.



That's the point.



You need to be the kind of person who can take unstructured time and turn it into something valuable.



---



What We're Looking For



Required



**Multi-Channel Marketing Strategy Experience**



You have experience setting direction across multiple channels, ideally including:



* SEO

* Google Ads

* Meta Ads

* Social Media

* Content Marketing

*
 Marketing

* Brand Strategy



We are **not** looking for someone who specializes in one channel and simply coordinates the others.



Strong Research Experience



You have personally conducted work such as:



* Market research

* Competitive analysis

* Customer research

* Personas

* Brand positioning

* Audience research

* Industry analysis



Be prepared to walk us through a real project in detail.



Genuine Curiosity



One of the strongest indicators of success in this role is curiosity.



We want someone who has gone deep into a subject simply because they wanted to understand it.



It does not have to be marketing.



Strong AI Research Skills



You understand AI as a **research and reasoning instrument**, not simply a faster way to write.



You should be comfortable:



* Prompting

* Iterating

* Fact-checking

* Comparing sources

* Challenging AI outputs

* Building repeatable AI research workflows



We may assess this skill live.



### Strong Critical Thinking



You naturally ask:



* *How do we know this?*

* *What is the source?*

* *What assumption are we making?*

* *What would prove this wrong?*

* *Is there another explanation?*

* *What information are we missing?*



Comfortable Giving Direct Feedback



You will have authority over work produced by other team members.



You need to be comfortable saying:



**“This isn't right yet.”**



More importantly, you need to explain exactly **what needs to change and why.**



Self-Directed



Some of the most important work in this position will not come with a deadline.



You need to be able to identify valuable work, prioritize it, and execute without someone constantly telling you what to do next.



### Communication



* Excellent written English

* Strong analytical communication

* Comfortable working with US-based clients and colleagues

* Able to explain complex strategic ideas clearly

* Comfortable participating in client-facing discussions



---



Nice to Have



Experience with:



* Digital marketing agencies

* Google Ads

* Meta Ads

* Paid audience and targeting strategy

* Google Search Console

* GA4

* SEO platforms and analytics

* Marketing dashboards and reporting

* Competitive intelligence

* Brand strategy

* Marketing automation

* AI research workflows

* Creating documented processes that another person can follow



---



What This Job Is NOT



This may not be the right role if you are primarily looking for:



* A content writing position

* An SEO specialist position

* A paid ads specialist position

* A social media manager position

* A role where someone else provides the strategy

* A position where you simply execute instructions

* A job where AI is used primarily to generate content faster



**Our copywriters write. Our designers design. Our specialists execute.**



**You determine what should be done, why it should be done, who it should reach, and how we know it is working.**



---



About the Working Environment



This is a senior individual contributor position



There are no direct reports, but the role comes with real strategic authority.



Client-facing work does not move forward without your approval.



Rohring Results is a growing company, so not every process is perfectly established. Part of this role will involve helping us improve and document how strategy is developed and delivered.



Our delivery team primarily works on **Philippine hours**, including daily stand-ups.



Some client-facing meetings may take place during US hours. We will explain the expected schedule during the interview process.



---



How to Apply



Please submit your CV/Resume along with two short paragraphs answering the following:



1. A Research Question You Answered Well



Tell us:



* What were you trying to find out?

* How did you conduct the research?

* What sources did you use?

* How did you evaluate the information?

* How did you know your conclusion was reliable?

* What decision did the research ultimately influence?



2. A Time AI Gave You the Wrong Answer



Tell us about a situation where:



* An AI tool gave you an answer that appeared reasonable

* You discovered that it was wrong or misleading

* Explain how you identified the problem

* Explain how you verified the correct information

* Explain what you changed in your process afterward



**We read these answers before the rest of the application.**



They will tell us much more about how you think than a generic cover letter.



---

If you are naturally curious, skeptical of easy answers, comfortable with ambiguity, and genuinely enjoy figuring out *what is actually true*—we would like to meet you.



Apply with your CV and the two requested responses above. send to

title: Appointment Setter / Sales Closer — High-Ticket B2B Offer
description:
About us



The Studio Formula is a done-for-you client acquisition service for boutique Pilates and fitness studio owners in the UK, US, Canada and Australia. We build and run their paid ads, landing pages and follow-up automation so their classes fill.



We're not a coaching company and we don't sell a course. The founder owns and operates a Pilates studio running 91% class occupancy and 57% profit margins — and has never taught a class in it. That studio is where the system was built, and it's the proof the offer rests on.



The offer is $3,000 setup + $1,997/month on a 90-day program, backed by a written guarantee: we agree a member target with the client on the call, and if we miss it we refund the setup fee and keep working free until we hit it.



What you'll do



You own everything from booked application to closed client:



- Work inbound applications from paid ads — no cold calling, no DM prospecting, no list building

- Confirm and re-confirm booked calls so people actually show up (this is half the job)

- Chase no-shows and rebook them

- Run the 45-minute Strategy Call: work through the prospect's real numbers (classes per week, occupancy, member value), calculate what their empty class spots cost them monthly, and close the ones who fit

- Disqualify the ones who don't. Studios under $20,000/month get turned away — we'd rather lose the sale than take money from someone it won't work for

- Keep GoHighLevel clean: notes, pipeline stages, follow-up tasks



Hours



Calls run in United States timezone:

- US East Coast: late evening / overnight PHT

You need to be genuinely available in the US block. That's where the leads currently are.



Full-time paid position available after 3 months of proven results. We run other offers, and a setter/closer who proves out on this one moves into a salaried role across the portfolio. That's the actual path here — this is a proving ground, not a permanent commission arrangement.



What we're honest about



We'd rather tell you now than have you quit in week two:



This offer is early. We are building the sales process, not handing you a finished one. There is no proven script yet. You'll be building it with the founder from real call recordings.

Lead volume is currently low — single-digit applications per week while we scale ad spend. If you need 20 calls a week to make your numbers, this isn't your role yet.

Show rate is currently poor (~25%). Fixing that is the single biggest thing you can do here and the fastest way to earn.

If you want guaranteed income from day one, apply somewhere else. If you want a percentage of a high-ticket offer you helped build, and a full-time seat if it works, read on.

Requirements

2+ years closing or setting for info products, coaching, consulting, agency or other high-ticket B2B offers. This is non-negotiable — we will ask for specifics and check them.

Comfortable holding a 45-minute consultative call with a business owner who has real money at stake

Excellent spoken English, neutral or Western accent. You'll be speaking with UK, US and Australian business owners about a $5,000+ commitment. They need to feel they're talking to a peer.

Confident with numbers — you'll be doing live arithmetic on a prospect's occupancy and member value on the call

title: Operations & Customer Support Assistant — AU Company, Day Shift, ₱35-45K
description:
About us



Lee Mathematics Tuition is a fast-growing online maths tutoring company based in Sydney, Australia, supporting 245 families and 261 students across the country. We match students with expert tutors and look after them through their whole learning journey. Our operations team is small and tight, and we are growing fast - so we need another reliable set of hands.



About the role



You will work alongside our Student Success Manager, who you report to day to day.



You are the voice our families hear. When a parent rings because their child is sick, or their tutor has not shown up, or they need to move tomorrow's lesson - you are the person who picks up, sorts it, and makes them feel looked after. That is the heart of this job.



The other half of the job is getting new students started. When a family signs up, you own them until their first lesson has actually happened. Our system does the heavy lifting of working out which tutors are a good fit and are free - but a system cannot get a busy tutor to reply, and it cannot pin a family down to an exact day and time. That part is yours. You will be messaging tutors back and forth, confirming the precise times with the parent and the student, and getting the lesson locked into the calendar. It is a real back-and-forth job, it takes persistence, and it is a big part of your week.



A lot of the repetitive admin here is already automated, and more of it will be. So what we actually need from you is the part a system cannot do - warmth on the phone, chasing people who have not replied yet, good judgment when something does not fit the rules, and never dropping a ball when three things land at once.



What you will do



- Answer and return parent calls, texts and
s - promptly, warmly, and in a way that leaves them feeling looked after

- Handle whatever comes up during the evening lesson window - a tutor running late, a student not showing, a parent asking if tonight is still on

- Coordinate tutors and families to get new students booked in - our system shortlists who can take a student, then you message the tutors, agree the exact days and times with the parent, and lock the lesson into the calendar

- Own each new family until their first lesson has happened - records set up, tutor confirmed, first lesson booked, and the family told what to expect

- Send welcome messages, first-lesson check-ins and payment reminders (templated - you are not writing these from scratch)

- Help out with some billing admin - chasing up unpaid invoices and following up with families, working alongside our team

- Keep our task boards and records accurate so nothing slips between people - including chasing tutors who have not written up their lesson notes yet



Who you are



- Warm, clear, confident English on the phone with Australian parents. You are comfortable ringing someone back, and comfortable being the person who says "leave that with me." This is the single most important thing.

- Good judgment. Much of this job is situations that do not quite fit the rule. We will give you a clear list of what you can d
 on your own - we need someone who will actually use it rather than checking in on everything.

- Exceptionally organised. You juggle many things at once, prioritise fast, and stay calm and methodical when it is busy.

- Persistent, in a friendly way. A lot of this job is people not replying yet. You are comfortable following up a tutor for the third time without it becoming awkward, and you do not let something sit just because you are waiting on someone else.

- Reliable and proactive - you follow things through and keep your own systems tidy without being chased.

- Comfortable learning new software quickly (we use TutorBird, Notion, Asana and Aircall, and you will be on Slack with our team and WhatsApp with our tutors every day).

- Available for the hours below, including the afternoon/evening shift, plus one weekend morning.



Nice to have



- Experience in operations, admin, coordination, or a virtual assistant role

- Experience speaking with English-speaking (ideally Australian) customers by phone



Details



- Full time, remote (work from home)

- These are normal daytime hours. This is not a night shift - we are in Australia, so our working day lines up closely with yours.

- Your first month - training: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM Manila time. You will work these hours alongside our Student Success Manager while you learn the role.

- After that, ongoing: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM - 6:30 PM Manila time. From 4 October this becomes 9:00 AM - 5:30 PM Manila, so that your Australian hours stay the same through daylight saving. This is the busiest part of our day - lessons run in the Australian evening, so that is when parents call - and for the last few hours you will be the only one on. It is a role with real ownership, and we will move you onto it once you are confident, not on day one.

- Plus 2.5 hours on one weekend morning (Saturday or Sunday - we will agree which with you). Around 45 hrs/week in total.

- PHP 35,000 - 45,000/month, and where you start in that range depends on your experience - for the right person we will start you above the bottom of it.

- The pay increases are real and important to us as we want you to grow with us. Your rate is reviewed at the end of your 2-month probation and again at 6 months, and it steps up as you take on the full role.

- 13th month pay provided of course. 

- Paid time off - 3 paid sick days and 6 paid public holidays each year

- A long-term role on a small team that is growing fast. We have gone from around 130 families at the start of this year to 245 today, and you would be one of only two people running operations for all of them. There is real room to grow here as we scale, and we would rather grow the people we have than keep hiring around them.



How to apply



Start your application with the word SYDNEY so we know you read this properly.



Then send us a 2-3 minute video - just talk us through these three things in one go:



1. A quick intro about yourself

2. This scenario: "A parent rings you at 6pm, upset. Their tutor has been late twice in two weeks, and tonight they were 15 minutes late again. The parent wants to know whether they are being charged for the full lesson. Talk to them - what do you actually say?"

3. And this one: "Three things land at the same time. A parent is waiting on a call back about tomorrow's lesson, a tutor has just messaged to say they cannot make tonight, and two new families need their first lessons booked this week. What do you do first, and why? And how do you keep track of the other two so they do not get forgotten?"



Film it on your phone. One take is fine and it does not need to be polished - we would rather see you thinking than see you rehearsed. Share it as a link (Google Drive, Loom, or YouTube unlisted).



We want to see and hear how you come across, how you handle someone who is unhappy, and how you organise yourself when several things need you at once.



Shortlisted applicants will do a live interview including a role-played parent call and a short hands-on organisation exercise.

title: Expert Performance Video Editor
description:
Performance Video Editor

Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience + uncapped performance bonuses

About Exchange Life

Exchange Life is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brands in the US. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new products launching soon. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram.

This role is video, end to end. You'll concept and cut short-form video ads for paid media across TikTok, Reels, and Meta placements, where every edit is judged on what it does to hook rate, retention, and spend. You're not making brand films or organic filler. You're making the creative we put budget behind.

We're looking for an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals, not just execute tasks. This is not a gig; it's a long-term partnership. Many of our editors have been with us 2+ years, and the people who now set our creative direction started as editors here.

You'll work closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. We're a small, high-output team that moves fast, communicates daily, and invests in the people who show up.

Where You'll Be in Six Months

Senior Performance Video Editor.

That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. At that level you have full creative autonomy: you own video concepts end to end, you d
 which angles we test next instead of receiving briefs, your creatives are the ones we put real spend behind, and you start reviewing other editors' cuts and shaping how they work.

It's d
 by performance, not time served. Move faster if your work moves faster.

Compensation & Earning Potential

Base: $10–20 USD/hour depending on experience

Performance bonuses: Uncapped, paid per winning creative. Every video that hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid ads pays out.

Rate reviews: Revisited as you take on more, not on an annual calendar

Our top editors earn meaningfully more than their base because they produce winners consistently. That's the whole design: we'd rather pay a lot for creatives that work than a little for creatives that don't.

What Success Looks Like

After 3–6 months, a successful hire is consistently producing short-form video ads that scale on paid and perform organically, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats without needing direction from the marketing team. You'll be a trusted creative partner, not just an executor.

Core Responsibilities

Concept and edit short-form video ads for TikTok, Reels, and Meta, built around hook rate, retention, and watch time rather than aesthetics

Develop new video angles and hooks, then test them against our proven formats

Build AI-assisted video creative using current tools, and keep pace as those tools change

Review your past edits daily, identify what's working and what isn't, and improve without repeating mistakes

Work directly from paid performance data to d
 what to cut next

Turn around content quickly and communicate proactively every day, with no check-ins required

Stay on top of TikTok and Instagram trends and apply them where they'll actually convert

Must-Haves

A strong recent portfolio of short-form video edits, ideally including paid ad creative (20+ from the last few months)

You can watch a winning video ad and break down exactly what made it work

Hands-on experience across video formats: hook-led headline videos, talking heads, voiceovers, UGC-style edits, AI video

Ability to read metrics (hook rate, retention, watch time, spend) and know what to change in the next cut

Takes ownership, internalizes feedback, doesn't repeat the same mistake twice

Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Strong written and spoken English; able to work independently

Nice-to-Haves

Experience cutting video ads for e-commerce or DTC brands

Experience working directly against Meta or TikTok ad account data

A track record of creatives that scaled on paid

What You'll Learn Here

Most editing jobs teach you software. This one teaches you why video sells.

Direct access to paid performance data on real ad spend, so you see exactly which of your creatives print and which die

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software, including the AI video tools you'll be working in

A portfolio backed by numbers, not vibes. "This cut did 4M views and scaled to $X/day" is a career asset that follows you.

Not a Fit If

Your portfolio is mostly long-form, YouTube, or event/wedding content

You can't point to a recent video ad and explain why it performed

You want to make beautiful videos more than videos that sell

You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

Working Style

Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you turn work around quickly and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools: CapCut Pro (or comparable), AI video tools, TikTok/Meta analytics

Working style: No micromanagement

How to Apply

It takes about 5 minutes. We review every application.



APPLY HERE:

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

title: Marketing Agency Operations Coordinator / Executive VA — GoHighLevel, SOPs, Team Support
description:
Compensation and schedule



• Part-time to start: 20–30 hours per week

• Starting rate: $3.50 USD per hour

• 30-day paid probation with written 30/60/90-day reviews

• Opportunity to grow into full-time work and an agency operations manager role

• Long-term compensation can grow toward $3,000 USD per month only if the role expands to independently managing a profitable client portfolio and delivery team; this is a career path, not a guaranteed or immediate salary

• At least three hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours



About the role



Downpour Marketing is an owner-led startup agency for exterior home-service companies. Our initial portfolio includes paver sealing/exterior cleaning, roofing, pressure washing, and gutter companies.



We need a resourceful marketing operations coordinator who can help the founder turn scattered work into a dependable system. This is initially a hands-on support and coordination role—not an equity partnership and not full authority to run the company. You will organize client work, maintain project boards, document SOPs, help test GoHighLevel systems, research and screen specialist contractors, prepare draft client updates, and make sure blocked work is surfaced early.



The right person can earn more responsibility and compensation as the agency gains paying retainer clients and the person demonstrates sound judgment.



Initial responsibilities



• Maintain project boards, owners, due dates, dependencies, and approval queues

• Prepare draft client updates and weekly scorecards for founder review

• Keep raw leads, qualified leads, booked estimates, sold jobs, revenue, and gross profit separate

• Document SOPs, checklists, access inventories, and change logs

• Assist with GoHighLevel pipelines, forms, workflows, calendars, and QA checklists in test or limited-access environments

• Research and pre-screen SEO, paid-media, content, design, website, automation, and CRM specialists

• Schedule interviews and organize candidate evidence; the founder makes all hiring decisions

• Follow up on late or blocked tasks and escalate risks instead of hiding them



Required qualifications



• At least one year supporting a marketing agency, home-service business, or client-delivery team

• Working knowledge of GoHighLevel or a similar CRM

• Strong written and spoken English

• Organized with ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Trello, or a similar system

• Comfortable learning new tools and documenting repeatable processes

• Able to provide one sanitized work sample and two professional references

• Honest about what you know, what you do not know, and when founder approval is required



Strong advantages



• Home-services marketing experience

• GoHighLevel workflows and subaccounts

• Local SEO or Google Business Profile support

• CallRail, Zapier, Make, n8n, GA4, Search Console, or Looker Studio

• Candidate sourcing, contractor coordination, or quality assurance



Trust and access boundaries



• The application and paid test use fictional or redacted data; no live credentials or customer data are provided.

• Initial access is least-privilege through a named account with MFA. Shared owner passwords are never provided.

• The coordinator cannot change ad spend, publish publicly, deploy production changes, hire or commit vendors, promise client deliverables, export customer data, change permissions, or authorize payments without written founder approval.

• Client-facing communication begins as drafts for founder approval.

• Access grows only after references, work samples, paid-test performance, and documented on-the-job judgment are verified.



How to apply



Start your application with STORM VA and answer all six items:



1. What marketing agency or home-service work have you supported, and what did you personally own?

2. Describe one late, broken, or confusing project you helped organize. What did you do and what evidence showed it improved?

3. Describe your hands-on GoHighLevel or CRM experience. Be specific about forms, pipelines, workflows, calendars, or reporting.

4. Explain how you would report this funnel: 47 raw leads, 31 qualified, 14 booked estimates, 6 sold jobs, $28,000 sold revenue, and $19,000 collected revenue.

5. State your desired hourly rate, current commitments, earliest start date, and daily U.S. Eastern-time overlap.

6. Confirm that you are comfortable starting with limited access, written approvals, and a 30-day paid probation.



Include a 2–3 minute video introducing yourself and explaining how you would organize five home-service accounts during your first week. Do not read a generic script.



Paid finalist test



• Estimated time: 2–3 hours

• Fixed payment: $20 USD

• Uses a fictional company and redacted sample data

• Deliverables: a one-week project board, a one-page weekly report, a GoHighLevel lead-flow test checklist, a short risk register, and a recorded walkthrough

• No unpaid spec work and no live-account access



Promotion path



This role can progress from coordinator to full-time operations lead as the agency adds profitable recurring clients. Raises and expanded access require documented delivery quality, reliable communication, clean QA, verified references, and increasing responsibility. Compensation approaching $3,000 USD per month would require independently managing a meaningful profitable client portfolio and delivery team; it is not promised on a fixed timeline.

title: Video Editor for Real Estate Social Media
description:
Foraker Realty Co. is looking for a creative and dependable video editor to help produce engaging social media content for our real estate agents and brokerage.



This is not primarily a traditional property tour editing position. Most projects will feature agents speaking on camera and will be designed to educate, build their personal brands, showcase properties, generate leads or recruit agents to the brokerage.



You will initially receive clear direction, reference videos and feedback. As you learn our style and consistently produce strong work, you will have opportunities to take greater creative control over projects.



Content You Will Edit



Projects may include:



* Short vertical Reels under 60 seconds

* Vertical social videos between one and two minutes

* Horizontal videos for
 and YouTube

* Agent talking head videos

* Educational real estate content

* Testimonials and interviews

* Property focused social videos

* Paid recruiting advertisements

* Brokerage branding content



The workload will vary from week to week. Some projects will be straightforward social edits, while others will require more polished or cinematic storytelling.



Responsibilities



* Select the strongest takes and arrange footage into an engaging story

* Remove mistakes, pauses and unnecessary sections

* Create clean pacing that keeps viewers engaged

* Add animated captions and on screen graphics

* Incorporate property footage, additional footage, music and sound effects

* Perform professional color correction and basic color grading

* Clean up dialogue and balance music, sound effects and voice audio

* Create thumbnails or social media cover images when requested

* Export vertical and horizontal videos in the correct formats

* Complete revisions accurately and respond well to feedback

* Meet the deadline established for each project



Editable project files will not normally be required. Final exported videos will be the primary deliverable.



Required Qualifications



You must have:



* A strong professional short form video portfolio

* Experience editing talking head or interview content

* Strong color correction and audio cleanup skills

* Experience creating motion graphics and animated captions

* An understanding of social media pacing and viewer retention

* The ability to produce fast paced, clean and cinematic styles depending on the project

* A computer capable of editing professional video footage

* Reliable internet suitable for downloading and uploading large video files

* Strong attention to detail

* Clear written communication

* The ability to follow instructions and meet agreed upon deadlines



You may use Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve or another professional editing program. The quality of your finished work is more important than the specific software you use.



Previous real estate experience is helpful but not required.



Schedule and Compensation



This is a deadline based remote position without fixed working hours. You may create your own schedule as long as you communicate clearly and deliver projects by their agreed upon deadlines.



The expected rate after the initial testing stage is **$8 to $12 USD per hour**, based on experience, editing ability and efficiency.



Because our project volume varies, this position will begin with a staged paid evaluation:



1. One paid test video

2. Three additional paid videos for candidates who pass the first test

3. A paid trial period lasting approximately one to four weeks

4. The possibility of consistent long term work if the trial is successful



Every stage of the evaluation will be paid. Additional work and responsibility may become available as the relationship develops.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the words **“Foraker Video Editor”** so we know you read the complete posting.



Include the following:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your editing editing experience

2. Links to your three best short form video edits

3. At least one talking head or interview example

4. The editing software you use

5. Your computer specifications

6. Your requested hourly rate

7. Your general availability

8. Your location and time zone



Please only submit work that you personally edited. If you worked as part of a team, explain which parts of the project you completed.



Make sure all portfolio links are publicly accessible and do not require permission to view.



We are looking for someone who wants to develop a long term working relationship, learn our brand and eventually contribute creatively, rather than simply complete one time editing projects.

title: Construction Employer Outreach and Recruitment Specialist
description:
We are seeking a confident, persistent, and professional Virtual Assistant to contact construction companies and recruit contractors willing to hire graduates from our construction training program.



Our trainees receive hands on construction training and will be prepared for entry level construction employment after graduation. The Virtual Assistant will be responsible for building relationships with construction employers and securing signed participation agreements from companies that have legitimate hiring needs.



Project Goal



The first phase of this project must be completed within 7 to 10 days.



During this period, the Virtual Assistant must secure signed participation agreements from 20 qualified construction contractors who are willing to interview and hire eligible program graduates at a minimum starting wage of $21 per hour.



Responsibilities



• Research qualified construction companies and contractors



• Make outbound calls to business owners, hiring managers, and other decision makers



• Introduce our construction training and job placement program



• Explain the skills and preparation trainees receive



• Identify contractors with current or upcoming hiring needs



• Confirm that contractors are willing and able to pay at least $21 per hour



• Secure completed and signed contractor participation agreements



• Collect all required employer information and documentation



• Schedule follow up calls with interested contractors



• Maintain accurate records of every call, contact, response, and follow up date



• Provide regular progress reports throughout the project



• Follow up with contractors when graduates are ready for interviews and placement



• Help track graduate employment through the 90 day retention period



Contractor Requirements



To qualify toward the project goal, each contractor must:



• Operate a legitimate construction business



• Have a current or upcoming need for workers



• Agree to consider, interview, or hire qualified program graduates



• Agree to pay hired graduates a minimum starting wage of $21 per hour



• Complete and sign the required contractor participation agreement



• Provide accurate company and hiring information



Contractor contact information without a completed and verified participation agreement will not count toward the project goal.



Qualifications



• Strong spoken and written English



• Confident and professional telephone presence



• Experience with outbound calling, recruiting, appointment setting, sales, or lead generation



• Comfortable speaking with construction company owners and hiring managers



• Strong organizational and follow up skills



• Able to work independently and meet strict deadlines



• Able to complete a high volume of calls within 7 to 10 days



• Comfortable working in a performance based position



• Experience in construction recruiting, workforce development, or employer outreach is preferred, but not required



Compensation



This is a performance based independent contract position with total earning potential of $2,500.



• $1,000 after 20 qualified construction contractors sign the required participation agreements within 7 to 10 days



• $1,000 after eligible program graduates are hired by participating contractors at a minimum starting wage of $21 per hour



• $500 completion bonus after the hired graduates successfully complete 90 days of employment and all required documentation has been submitted



All results must be verified before payment is issued. Incomplete agreements, invalid companies, duplicate contractors, or contact information without signed agreements will not qualify for payment.



To Apply



Please provide the following:



• A brief introduction



• A summary of your outbound calling, recruiting, or lead generation experience



• A short voice recording introducing yourself to a construction company



• Your availability and time zone



• The number of outbound calls you can complete each day



• Examples of similar projects or results



• Confirmation that you understand this is a performance based position



We are looking for someone who is persuasive, organized, professional, and capable of producing verified results within the required timeline.

We create reaction and taste test style videos — think "Moms Try International Snacks," "Friends Try Asian Candy," and lifestyle food content with warm, fun energy. If you're familiar with channels like Cocoa Butter or similar reaction/taste test formats you'll fit right in.

-Proven video editing experience — portfolio or YouTube channel examples required

nt needs room to land

Please include links to previous editing work with your application.

title: Executive Assistant to Director, Australian NDIS Provider (Full Time, Sydney Hours, PHP 55k to 100k)
description:
Eden Ability is a registered NDIS disability support provider in Sydney, Australia. We run supported independent living homes, respite and community access across Sydney. We already have one Filipino team member who has been with us for years, and we are hiring an experienced Executive Assistant to work directly with the Director.



This is a senior role with one boss. The Director runs several homes, a team of support workers and managers, and a busy personal life. Your job is to make his life easier: run his inbox and calendar, handle his business and personal admin, and follow up everything so nothing is missed and no deadline slips.



The heart of this job is follow up. Every day you will be on the phone, on
 and on text chasing staff, managers, families, support coordinators, the NDIA and suppliers until the job is actually done. You keep your own list of everything in motion and you never need to be reminded. You are the person who makes sure everyone is doing their job properly, and you do it with warmth and confidence so people want to help you. You are comfortable calling an Australian government agency or a hospital discharge team and getting an answer.



You will also own the NDIS paperwork: service agreements, client intake, staff compliance documents, and keeping ShiftCare and SharePoint tidy and current.



We want someone who has done this before at executive level, uses their own judgement, and does not need to be told twice.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Chase. Staff, managers, families, support coordinators, agencies and suppliers, by phone,
 and text, until it is done. Then confirm it is done.

- Keep a running list of every task, promise and deadline in the business and make sure none of them are missed.

- Draft
s, letters and simple reports in clear Australian English.

WHAT WE NEED

- Confident on the phone. You will call Australians every day, including people who do not want to be chased, and you can be friendly and firm at the same time.

WHAT YOU GET

HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word MASCOT so we know you read this. Attach your CV as a PDF. Then answer these four questions. Short, specific answers please. No generic cover letters.

title: Graphic Designer + Video Editor
description:
ABOUT US



We are an established North American ecommerce company, sixteen years old, selling reusable, sustainable products directly to consumers. We are small, we move fast, and we have been profitable and independent the whole way.



We want a Design person who would like to own the Graphic Design department of our business.



SCHEDULE



Work your own daytime hours in the Philippines. We need 2 to 4 hours of overlap with our mornings in North American Eastern Time, which is roughly 9pm to 1am Manila time, so we can review work and get revisions back same day.



THE HONEST SHAPE OF THIS JOB



This is a graphic design job with a daily video routine attached.



The video side is not hard. We edit in 
 (check it out, if you haven't) , which is text based editing, so cutting a video is mostly deleting the sentences you do not want. There are no complex transitions, no motion graphics, no colour grading. It is cut, cut, cut, assemble, caption, publish. If you have never used Descript, we will teach you in a day. All of these videos go on our Social Media channels that have a combined following of 600,000 people. We use the same + some additional videos to make ads.



The design side is where we need you to be genuinely good. Packaging, ad creative, product page graphics,
. That is where your portfolio has to earn it.



Expect your week to be roughly 40 percent video and publishing, 60 percent design.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



1. DAILY VIDEO AND PUBLISHING

- Around 10 new video cuts per week, edited in Descript from raw footage of our founder talking to camera

- Repurpose and reformat existing videos so we have 2 posts going out per day

- Add captions, on-screen text, music and simple graphics

- Upload and schedule everything in Metricool for YouTube Shorts, TikTok and LinkedIn

- Write the social captions for each video and put them in a shared Google Drive doc, then send the link over so the Instagram and
 posts can go out 
 from the app

- Occasional longer horizontal edits for YouTube



2. PAID AD CREATIVE

- Static image ads for Meta, built from product photography, customer reviews and product benefits

- Multiple variations and sizes of each concept so we can test properly

- Video ad cutdowns from footage we already have



3. WEBSITE AND
 GRAPHICS

You are not building or redesigning the website. You are designing the things that go on it. If you have UI/UX experience - fantastic!!

- Product page graphics: infographics, feature callouts, size charts, comparison charts, how-to-use visuals

- Homepage and collection banners, campaign and landing page graphics

-
 graphics, banners and templates

- Product photo retouching and clean-up

- Everything mobile first, because most of our customers are on their phones



4. PACKAGING AND PRINT

- Edits and updates to existing packaging artwork and dielines

- New packaging for new products, working from our specs

- Inserts, hang tags, labels, care instruction cards, thank you cards

- Print ready files: correct bleed, CMYK, and files a manufacturer will not send back



You will also keep our brand assets organized so we stop losing files, and keep everything looking like it came from the same company.



WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE



- A portfolio of real design work. This is the thing that d
 it. We want to see packaging or print alongside digital work if you have both.

- Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator. You need to be genuinely fast in both.

- Print and packaging experience. You know what a dieline is, you set up bleed correctly, and you understand what a printer or manufacturer needs from you.

- An eye for what sells. Our ads and product graphics have a job to do. Pretty is not enough.

- Written English good enough to write our social captions. Your captions go out under our brand name.

- A reliable computer and internet that can handle moving large video files without you losing half a day to it.

- Curiosity about AI tools and a willingness to build them into your workflow. We want you faster, not replaced.



ON VIDEO EXPERIENCE: it is a bonus, not a requirement. We are not asking for a showreel. Descript is genuinely easy and we will teach you. If you have edited video before, tell us. If you have not, that will not count against you.



ON DEGREES: a design or fine arts education is a plus, not a requirement. We will read every portfolio properly regardless of what is on your resume.



ON EXPERIENCE: more is better, but we are open to someone fresh out of university, or still in it. We have hired people at that stage before and it worked out well. If your work is good, apply.



NICE TO HAVE



- Descript, or any text based video editor

- Premiere Pro or After Effects for the occasional heavier edit

- Figma

- Familiarity with Shopify page and section design

- Klaviyo or any
 platform

- Experience working with a direct to consumer brand or an ecommerce store



WHO THIS JOB IS NOT FOR



- Anyone who skims. We are detail people, and this job is full of details that cost real money if you miss them, like a bleed setting or a wrong price on a package. So here is the check: start your application with the word mango, in lowercase. It is the only place we mention it, and we will not remind you again further down. Applications without it get deleted without being read.

- Anyone who needs a creative director to hand them a brief. Nobody here is going to art direct you. You get the product, the footage and the goal, and you come back with the work.

- Anyone who is going to be quietly running four other clients at the same time. This is a full time job.

- Anyone who wants to only design and never touch the video routine. The daily publishing has to happen, every day, and it is part of the job.



HOW TO APPLY



There are two steps, and step one is quick on purpose. We do not want you spending hours on a task before we have even seen your work.



STEP 1, RIGHT NOW: send us your portfolio and your answers to the questions below.



Your portfolio. A link we can open without asking permission. Show us design work. If any piece was made with AI tools, say so next to it. We do not mind AI in the process, we mind being misled.



The questions. Short answers are fine, honest answers are better. Please don't use AI for the answers - we can detect it easily. We want you to write in your own words.



1. Rank these four from your strongest to your weakest: packaging and print, static ad design, website and
 graphics, video editing. Then tell us what you enjoy the most and why

2. Tell us about one thing you designed that had a job to do, like selling something or explaining something, and how you knew whether it worked. If it's something you did in university or for a client, please attach it with explanations.

3. Walk us through one packaging or print file you have prepared. What was it, what were the specs, and did it come back from the printer correctly the first time? If you have never done print work, say so and tell us about the most technically demanding file you have prepared instead.

4. Have you edited video before? If yes, what software and how long does a 60 second vertical video with captions take you. If no, just say no.

5. Which of these do you have you worked on before and for what purpose: Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Figma, Canva, Descript?



STEP 2, ONLY IF WE LIKE YOUR PORTFOLIO AND YOUR ANSWERS: a short test task will be given to you.



If your work is a fit, we will get in touch and send you a task that takes about 2 hours, using our real files. One static ad, one packaging text change, and one short video cut. Nobody gets asked to do this until we have looked at their portfolio and d
 we are interested, because we do not want to waste your time either.



WHAT WORKING HERE IS LIKE



Our founder & Operations Manager will be your main point of contact and the folks who will approve your work. We move fast, we say what we think, and we would rather you tell us an idea is bad than quietly make it. We will invest in your growth. Most people who work with us stay with us for 3 years minimum.



We are looking for someone who wants to stay and grow with business. Most of our team has been with us for years, and we would like this position to be that too.

title: Experienced Freight & Logistics Support Co-ordinator USA

You take ownership of your work and look for solutions rather than waiting for issues to escalate.

title: Marketing Manager: Social Media, Content, Design, Website and Meta Ads for Australian NDIS Provider (Full Time, PHP 50k to 90k)
description:

We already have Filipino team members who have been with us for years. We are now hiring one person to run all of our marketing.



This is a one person marketing department. You will own our social media, our content, our graphics, our website and our Meta ads, and you will use AI tools to do the work of three people. Our customers are NDIS participants, their families, support coordinators, hospital discharge teams and allied health professionals. Your job is to make sure they all know who Eden Ability is, fill our vacant rooms, and bring in referrals.



We do not want a specialist who only does one thing. We want someone who can design a post in the morning, write a landing page at lunch, launch a Meta ads campaign in the afternoon and report on all of it on Friday.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

, Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok: plan the calendar, create the content, post it, reply to comments and messages, and grow reach and followers.

 and Instagram) ads and Google ads: audiences, creatives, budgets, tracking, reporting. Tell us what is working and what to stop.
